flavor_text.gold: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
flavor_text.heartgold: The seed on its back is filled with nutrients. The seed grows steadily larger as its body grows.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

flavor_text.firered: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
flavor_text.gold: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
flavor_text.heartgold: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun’s rays, it fills its body with power.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
flavor_text.pearl: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.
flavor_text.platinum: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

flavor_text.sapphire: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR’s back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower’s aroma soothes the emotions of people.

flavor_text.yellow: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.

flavor_text.diamond: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavor_text.emerald: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
flavor_text.firered: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
flavor_text.gold: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
flavor_text.heartgold: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life force. If it is weak, the flame also burns weakly.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
flavor_text.pearl: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavor_text.platinum: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.
flavor_text.red: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.
flavor_text.ruby: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes enraged, the flame burns fiercely.

flavor_text.emerald: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
flavor_text.firered: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
flavor_text.gold: It is very hot headed by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.
flavor_text.pearl: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
flavor_text.platinum: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
flavor_text.red: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.
flavor_text.ruby: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.
flavor_text.sapphire: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.

flavor_text.blue: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
flavor_text.crystal: It uses its wings to fly high. The temperature of its fire increases as it gains exper ience in battle.
flavor_text.diamond: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavor_text.emerald: A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
flavor_text.firered: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
flavor_text.gold: If CHARIZARD be comes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a whitish- blue color.
flavor_text.heartgold: If CHARIZARD becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares up in a light blue shade.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
flavor_text.pearl: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said that CHARIZARD’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.
flavor_text.red: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.
flavor_text.ruby: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.

flavor_text.firered: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

flavor_text.heartgold: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.
flavor_text.leafgreen: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.
flavor_text.pearl: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

flavor_text.heartgold: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that WARTORTLE is very old.

flavor_text.diamond: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.
flavor_text.emerald: The waterspouts that protrude from its shell are highly accurate. Their bullets of water can precisely nail tin cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
flavor_text.firered: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
flavor_text.gold: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can with stand the recoil of the water jets it fires.
flavor_text.heartgold: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

flavor_text.diamond: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
flavor_text.emerald: Its voracious appetite compels it to devour leaves bigger than itself without hesitation. It releases a terribly strong odor from its antennae.
flavor_text.firered: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.
flavor_text.gold: For protection, it releases a horri ble stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
flavor_text.heartgold: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antennae on its head to drive away enemies.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
flavor_text.pearl: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.
flavor_text.platinum: It releases a stench from its red antenna to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

flavor_text.diamond: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. It quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

flavor_text.gold: Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it pre pares to evolve. It stays motion less in the shell.

flavor_text.diamond: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.
flavor_text.emerald: It has a superior ability to search for delicious honey from flowers. It can seek, extract, and carry honey from flowers blooming over six miles away.

flavor_text.heartgold: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.

flavor_text.diamond: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.
flavor_text.emerald: A WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense of smell. It distinguishes its favorite kinds of leaves from those it dislikes by sniffing with its big red proboscis (nose).

flavor_text.heartgold: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp stinger on its head that injects poison.
flavor_text.pearl: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

flavor_text.heartgold: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

flavor_text.pearl: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
flavor_text.platinum: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
flavor_text.red: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

flavor_text.diamond: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

flavor_text.firered: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
flavor_text.gold: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poi son stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
flavor_text.heartgold: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It flies at high speed and attacks using the large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
flavor_text.pearl: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
flavor_text.platinum: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.
flavor_text.red: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.
flavor_text.ruby: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest - this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
flavor_text.sapphire: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest - this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
flavor_text.silver: It has three poison barbs. The barb on its tail secretes the most powerful poison.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It has three poison barbs. The barb on its tail secretes the most powerful poison.
flavor_text.yellow: It has 3 poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

flavor_text.blue: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
flavor_text.crystal: It rapidly flaps its wings in the grass, stirring up a dust cloud that drives insect prey out into the open.
flavor_text.diamond: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavor_text.emerald: It has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It can unerringly return home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
flavor_text.firered: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.
flavor_text.gold: It usually hides in tall grass. Be cause it dislikes fighting, it pro tects itself by kicking up sand.
flavor_text.heartgold: It usually hides in tall grass. Because it dislikes fighting, it protects itself by kicking up sand.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
flavor_text.pearl: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavor_text.platinum: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.
flavor_text.red: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.
flavor_text.ruby: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
flavor_text.sapphire: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense of direction. It is capable of unerringly returning home to its nest, however far it may be removed from its familiar surroundings.
flavor_text.silver: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flap ping up sand.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.
flavor_text.yellow: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

flavor_text.crystal: It slowly flies in a circular pat tern, all the while keeping a sharp lookout for prey.
flavor_text.diamond: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavor_text.emerald: This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its large territory. If its living space is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
flavor_text.firered: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.
flavor_text.gold: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distin guish the move ments of its prey.
flavor_text.heartgold: It has outstanding vision. However high it flies, it is able to distinguish the movements of its prey.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
flavor_text.pearl: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavor_text.platinum: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.
flavor_text.red: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.
flavor_text.ruby: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its own territory. This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.
flavor_text.sapphire: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its own territory. This POKéMON flies around, patrolling its living space. If its territory is violated, it shows no mercy in thoroughly punishing the foe with its sharp claws.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.
flavor_text.yellow: This POKéMON is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

flavor_text.crystal: Its outstanding vision allows it to spot splashing MAGIKARP, even while flying at 3300 feet.
flavor_text.diamond: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
flavor_text.emerald: This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.
flavor_text.firered: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.
flavor_text.gold: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

flavor_text.platinum: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
flavor_text.red: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.
flavor_text.ruby: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.
flavor_text.yellow: This POKéMON flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

flavor_text.blue: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
flavor_text.crystal: This POKéMON's impressive vital ity allows it to live anywhere. It also multiplies very quickly.
flavor_text.diamond: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
flavor_text.emerald: A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.
flavor_text.firered: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.
flavor_text.gold: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.
flavor_text.heartgold: It eats anything. Wherever food is available, it will settle down and produce offspring continuously.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.
flavor_text.pearl: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
flavor_text.platinum: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.
flavor_text.red: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

flavor_text.crystal: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It search es wide areas for food.
flavor_text.diamond: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
flavor_text.emerald: A RATICATE’s sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
flavor_text.firered: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.
flavor_text.gold: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnaw ing on them.
flavor_text.heartgold: Gnaws on anything with its tough fangs. It can even topple concrete buildings by gnawing on them.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.
flavor_text.pearl: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

flavor_text.diamond: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavor_text.emerald: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.
flavor_text.firered: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.
flavor_text.gold: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
flavor_text.heartgold: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.
flavor_text.pearl: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavor_text.platinum: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.
flavor_text.red: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

flavor_text.blue: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
flavor_text.crystal: It uses its long beak to attack. It has a surprisingly long reach, so it must be treated with caution.
flavor_text.diamond: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavor_text.emerald: Its long neck and elongated beak are ideal for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves this extended and skinny beak to pluck prey.
flavor_text.firered: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.
flavor_text.gold: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
flavor_text.heartgold: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.
flavor_text.leafgreen: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
flavor_text.pearl: It has the stamina to keep flying all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavor_text.platinum: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.
flavor_text.red: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.
flavor_text.ruby: FEAROW is recognized by its long neck and elongated beak. They are conveniently shaped for catching prey in soil or water. It deftly moves its long and skinny beak to pluck prey.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It cleverly uses its thin, long beak to pluck and eat small insects that hide under the ground.
flavor_text.yellow: A POKéMON that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.

flavor_text.blue: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
flavor_text.crystal: It flutters the tip of its tongue to seek out the scent of prey, then swallows the prey whole.
flavor_text.diamond: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavor_text.emerald: An EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. This position allows it to quickly respond to an enemy from any direction with a threat from its upraised head.
flavor_text.firered: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.
flavor_text.gold: It can freely de tach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can be come too heavy to move, however.
flavor_text.heartgold: It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large prey whole. It can become too heavy to move, however.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
flavor_text.pearl: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavor_text.platinum: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.
flavor_text.red: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.
flavor_text.ruby: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.
flavor_text.sapphire: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while it rests. Assuming this position allows it to quickly respond to a threat from any direction with a glare from its upraised head.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It always hides in grass. When first born, it has no poison, so its bite is painful, but harmless.
flavor_text.yellow: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.

flavor_text.blue: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
flavor_text.crystal: To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its mouth.
flavor_text.diamond: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavor_text.emerald: This POKéMON has a terrifically strong constricting power. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once it wraps its body around its foe, escaping is impossible.
flavor_text.firered: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
flavor_text.gold: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.
flavor_text.heartgold: Transfixing prey with the face-like pattern on its belly, it binds and poisons the frightened victim.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
flavor_text.pearl: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavor_text.platinum: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.
flavor_text.red: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.
flavor_text.ruby: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once ARBOK wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in order to constrict things with its body. It can even flatten steel oil drums. Once ARBOK wraps its body around its foe, escaping its crunching embrace is impossible.
flavor_text.silver: With a very venge ful nature, it won't give up the chase, no matter how far, once it targets its prey.
flavor_text.soulsilver: With a very vengeful nature, it won’t give up the chase, no matter how far, once it targets its prey.
flavor_text.yellow: The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.

flavor_text.blue: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
flavor_text.crystal: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
flavor_text.diamond: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
flavor_text.emerald: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
flavor_text.firered: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
flavor_text.gold: This intelligent POKéMON roasts hard BERRIES with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
flavor_text.heartgold: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
flavor_text.pearl: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.
flavor_text.platinum: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow PIKACHU that is in a weakened state.
flavor_text.red: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
flavor_text.ruby: Whenever PIKACHU comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it’s evidence that this POKéMON mistook the intensity of its charge.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while PIKACHU sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
flavor_text.silver: It raises its tail to check its sur roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light ning in this pose.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
flavor_text.yellow: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.

flavor_text.blue: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
flavor_text.crystal: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electri city from the atmosphere.
flavor_text.diamond: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.
flavor_text.emerald: If it stores too much electricity, its behavior turns aggressive. To avoid this, it occasionally discharges excess energy and calms itself down.
flavor_text.firered: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.
flavor_text.gold: When its electric ity builds, its muscles are stimu lated, and it be comes more aggres sive than usual.
flavor_text.heartgold: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
flavor_text.pearl: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.
flavor_text.platinum: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
flavor_text.red: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.
flavor_text.ruby: If the electrical sacks become excessively charged, RAICHU plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this POKéMON’s nest.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON exudes a weak electrical charge from all over its body that makes it take on a slight glow in darkness. RAICHU searches for electricity by planting its tail in the ground.
flavor_text.silver: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.
flavor_text.yellow: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.

flavor_text.blue: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
flavor_text.crystal: It prefers dry, sandy places because it uses the sand to protect itself when threatened.
flavor_text.diamond: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
flavor_text.emerald: When it curls up in a ball, it can make any attack bounce off harmlessly. Its hide has turned tough and solid as a result of living in the desert.
flavor_text.firered: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
flavor_text.gold: If it fell from a great height, this POKéMON could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
flavor_text.heartgold: If it fell from a great height, this Pokémon could save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for prey.
flavor_text.pearl: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
flavor_text.platinum: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.
flavor_text.red: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.
flavor_text.ruby: SANDSHREW’s body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This POKéMON curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
flavor_text.sapphire: SANDSHREW has a very dry hide that is extremely tough. The POKéMON can roll into a ball that repels any attack. At night, it burrows into the desert sand to sleep.
flavor_text.silver: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.
flavor_text.yellow: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.

flavor_text.blue: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
flavor_text.crystal: Adept at climbing trees, it rolls into a spiny ball, then attacks its enemies from above.
flavor_text.diamond: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
flavor_text.emerald: It curls up in a ball to protect itself from enemy attacks. It also curls up to prevent heatstroke during the daytime when temperatures rise sharply.
flavor_text.firered: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.
flavor_text.gold: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
flavor_text.heartgold: In an attempt to hide itself, it will run around at top speed to kick up a blinding dust storm.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
flavor_text.pearl: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
flavor_text.platinum: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.
flavor_text.red: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
flavor_text.ruby: SANDSLASH’s body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
flavor_text.sapphire: SANDSLASH can roll up its body as if it were a ball covered with large spikes. In battle, this POKéMON will try to make the foe flinch by jabbing it with its spines. It then leaps at the stunned foe to tear wildly with its sharp claws.
flavor_text.silver: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
flavor_text.yellow: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.

flavor_text.crystal: Small and very docile, it pro tects itself with its small, poison ous horn when attacked.
flavor_text.diamond: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
flavor_text.emerald: Its highly toxic barbs are thought to have developed as protection for this small- bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
flavor_text.firered: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.
flavor_text.gold: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely po tent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
flavor_text.heartgold: The poison hidden in its small horn is extremely potent. Even a tiny scratch can have fatal results.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
flavor_text.pearl: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
flavor_text.platinum: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.
flavor_text.red: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.
flavor_text.ruby: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.
flavor_text.sapphire: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a powerful poison. They are thought to have developed as protection for this small-bodied POKéMON. When enraged, it releases a horrible toxin from its horn.

flavor_text.soulsilver: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.
flavor_text.yellow: A mild-mannered POKéMON that does not like to fight. Beware, its small horns secrete venom.

flavor_text.gold: When feeding its young, it first chews and tender izes the food, then spits it out for the offspring.
flavor_text.heartgold: When feeding its young, it first chews the food into a paste, then spits it out for the offspring.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The female’s horns develop slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.
flavor_text.pearl: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO’s.
flavor_text.platinum: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO’s.
flavor_text.red: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

flavor_text.diamond: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

flavor_text.firered: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.
flavor_text.gold: Its body is cover ed with needle- like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its body is covered with needle-like scales. It never shows signs of shrinking from any attack.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.
flavor_text.pearl: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
flavor_text.platinum: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.
flavor_text.red: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

flavor_text.crystal: It constantly moves its large ears in many directions in order to detect danger right away.
flavor_text.diamond: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavor_text.emerald: The male NIDORAN has developed muscles that freely move its ears in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this POKéMON’s notice.
flavor_text.firered: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.
flavor_text.gold: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is small, but its horn is filled with poison. It charges then stabs with the horn to inject poison.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.
flavor_text.pearl: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavor_text.platinum: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.
flavor_text.red: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

flavor_text.sapphire: The male NIDORAN has developed muscles for moving its ears. Thanks to them, the ears can be freely moved in any direction. Even the slightest sound does not escape this POKéMON’s notice.

flavor_text.crystal: It is easily agitated and uses its horn for offense as soon as it notices an attacker.
flavor_text.diamond: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
flavor_text.emerald: Its horn is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
flavor_text.firered: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.
flavor_text.gold: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses any thing, it attacks immediately.
flavor_text.heartgold: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.
flavor_text.leafgreen: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
flavor_text.pearl: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
flavor_text.platinum: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.
flavor_text.red: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.
flavor_text.ruby: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.
flavor_text.sapphire: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than a diamond. If it senses a hostile presence, all the barbs on its back bristle up at once, and it challenges the foe with all its might.

flavor_text.crystal: It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.
flavor_text.diamond: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
flavor_text.emerald: A NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power capable of toppling a metal transmission tower. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
flavor_text.firered: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.
flavor_text.gold: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
flavor_text.heartgold: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey’s bones.
flavor_text.pearl: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
flavor_text.platinum: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.
flavor_text.red: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.
flavor_text.ruby: NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
flavor_text.sapphire: NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
flavor_text.silver: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can snap the victim's spine quite easily.

flavor_text.yellow: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.

flavor_text.blue: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
flavor_text.crystal: Though rarely seen, it becomes easier to spot, for some reason, on the night of a full moon.
flavor_text.diamond: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
flavor_text.emerald: On every night of a full moon, they come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY go to sleep nestled up against each other in deep and quiet mountains.
flavor_text.firered: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.
flavor_text.gold: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
flavor_text.heartgold: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
flavor_text.leafgreen: With its magical and cute appeal, it has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
flavor_text.pearl: It flies using the wings on its back to collect moonlight. This Pokémon is difficult to find.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of CLEFAIRY dancing under a full moon.
flavor_text.red: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.
flavor_text.ruby: On every night of a full moon, groups of this POKéMON come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
flavor_text.sapphire: On every night of a full moon, groups of this POKéMON come out to play. When dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY return to their quiet mountain retreats and go to sleep nestled up against each other.
flavor_text.silver: Its adorable be havior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute POKéMON is rarely found.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.
flavor_text.yellow: Adored for their cute looks and playfulness. They are thought to be rare, as they do not appear often.

flavor_text.blue: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
flavor_text.crystal: Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.
flavor_text.diamond: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
flavor_text.emerald: A CLEFABLE uses its wings to skip lightly as if it were flying. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. On quiet, moonlit nights, it strolls on lakes.
flavor_text.firered: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
flavor_text.gold: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
flavor_text.heartgold: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
flavor_text.pearl: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.
flavor_text.platinum: It is very wary and rarely shows itself to people. Its ears can hear a pin drop over half a mile away.
flavor_text.red: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.
flavor_text.ruby: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
flavor_text.sapphire: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if it were flying using its wings. Its bouncy step lets it even walk on water. It is known to take strolls on lakes on quiet, moonlit nights.
flavor_text.silver: Its very sensitive ears lets it dis tinguish distant sounds. As a re sult, it prefers quiet places.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its very sensitive ears let it distinguish distant sounds. As a result, it prefers quiet places.
flavor_text.yellow: They appear to be very protective of their own world. It is a kind of fairy, rarely seen by people.

flavor_text.blue: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
flavor_text.crystal: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxur ious coat of fur.
flavor_text.diamond: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
flavor_text.emerald: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o’-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.
flavor_text.firered: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
flavor_text.gold: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
flavor_text.heartgold: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When it is born, it has just one snow- white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
flavor_text.pearl: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
flavor_text.platinum: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.
flavor_text.red: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
flavor_text.ruby: At the time of its birth, VULPIX has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this POKéMON receives plenty of love from its TRAINER. The six tails become magnificently curled.
flavor_text.sapphire: Inside VULPIX’s body burns a flame that never goes out. During the daytime, when the temperatures rise, this POKéMON releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.
flavor_text.silver: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.
flavor_text.yellow: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.

flavor_text.blue: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
flavor_text.crystal: It is said to live a thousand years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
flavor_text.diamond: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
flavor_text.emerald: It has long been said that each of the nine tails embody an enchanted power. A long-lived NINETALES will have fur that shines like gold.
flavor_text.firered: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
flavor_text.gold: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
flavor_text.heartgold: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
flavor_text.pearl: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
flavor_text.platinum: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.
flavor_text.red: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.
flavor_text.ruby: NINETALES casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe’s mind. This POKéMON is said to live for a thousand years.
flavor_text.sapphire: Legend has it that NINETALES came into being when nine wizards possessing sacred powers merged into one. This POKéMON is highly intelligent - it can understand human speech.
flavor_text.silver: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.
flavor_text.yellow: According to an enduring legend, 9 noble saints were united and reincarnated as this POKéMON.

flavor_text.blue: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
flavor_text.crystal: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.
flavor_text.diamond: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
flavor_text.emerald: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF’s song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.
flavor_text.firered: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
flavor_text.gold: If it inflates to SING a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
flavor_text.heartgold: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
flavor_text.pearl: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
flavor_text.platinum: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.
flavor_text.red: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
flavor_text.ruby: JIGGLYPUFF’s vocal chords can freely adjust the wavelength of its voice. This POKéMON uses this ability to sing at precisely the right wavelength to make its foes most drowsy.
flavor_text.sapphire: When this POKéMON sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, JIGGLYPUFF cannot breathe, endangering its life.
flavor_text.silver: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.
flavor_text.yellow: Uses its alluring eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

flavor_text.blue: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
flavor_text.crystal: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.
flavor_text.diamond: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
flavor_text.emerald: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.
flavor_text.firered: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.
flavor_text.gold: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.
flavor_text.heartgold: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
flavor_text.pearl: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
flavor_text.platinum: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.
flavor_text.red: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
flavor_text.ruby: WIGGLYTUFF has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this POKéMON’s eyes, it is quickly washed away.
flavor_text.sapphire: WIGGLYTUFF’s body is very flexible. By inhaling deeply, this POKéMON can inflate itself seemingly without end. Once inflated, WIGGLYTUFF bounces along lightly like a balloon.
flavor_text.silver: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a BODY SLAM.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.
flavor_text.yellow: Its body is full of elasticity. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.

flavor_text.blue: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
flavor_text.crystal: During the day, it gathers with others and hangs from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.
flavor_text.diamond: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
flavor_text.emerald: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.
flavor_text.firered: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
flavor_text.gold: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its sur roundings.
flavor_text.heartgold: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It forms colonies in perpetually dark places and uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
flavor_text.pearl: Disliking sunlight, it sleeps deep in forests and caves until sundown.
flavor_text.platinum: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
flavor_text.red: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
flavor_text.ruby: ZUBAT remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
flavor_text.sapphire: ZUBAT avoids sunlight because exposure causes it to become unhealthy. During the daytime, it stays in caves or under the eaves of old houses, sleeping while hanging upside down.
flavor_text.silver: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.
flavor_text.yellow: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for ob jects in its way.

flavor_text.blue: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
flavor_text.crystal: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.
flavor_text.diamond: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.
flavor_text.emerald: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and POKéMON. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.
flavor_text.firered: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.
flavor_text.gold: However hard its victim's hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
flavor_text.heartgold: However hard its victim’s hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
flavor_text.pearl: Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop until it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.
flavor_text.platinum: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.
flavor_text.red: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.
flavor_text.ruby: GOLBAT loves to drink the blood of living things. It is particularly active in the pitch black of night. This POKéMON flits around in the night skies, seeking fresh blood.
flavor_text.sapphire: GOLBAT bites down on prey with its four fangs and drinks the victim’s blood. It becomes active on inky dark moonless nights, flying around to attack people and POKéMON.
flavor_text.silver: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.
flavor_text.yellow: It attacks in a stealthy manner, without warning. Its sharp fangs are used to bite and suck blood.

flavor_text.blue: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
flavor_text.crystal: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bath ing in moonlight.
flavor_text.diamond: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavor_text.emerald: This POKéMON grows by absorbing moonlight. During the daytime, it buries itself in the ground, leaving only its leaves exposed to avoid detection by its enemies.
flavor_text.firered: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.
flavor_text.gold: Awakened by moon light, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
flavor_text.heartgold: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day, it stays quietly underground.
flavor_text.leafgreen: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
flavor_text.pearl: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavor_text.platinum: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.
flavor_text.red: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.
flavor_text.ruby: During the daytime, ODDISH buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients from the ground using its entire body. The more fertile the soil, the glossier its leaves become.
flavor_text.sapphire: ODDISH searches for fertile, nutrient- rich soil, then plants itself. During the daytime, while it is planted, this POKéMON’s feet are thought to change shape and become similar to the roots of trees.
flavor_text.silver: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.
flavor_text.yellow: It may be mistaken for a clump of weeds. If you try to yank it out of the ground, it shrieks horribly.

flavor_text.blue: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
flavor_text.crystal: The smell from its drool-like syrup and the pollen on its petals is so bad, it may make opponents faint.
flavor_text.diamond: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
flavor_text.emerald: A horribly noxious honey drools from its mouth. One whiff of the honey can result in memory loss. Some fans are said to enjoy this overwhelming stink, however.
flavor_text.firered: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
flavor_text.gold: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
flavor_text.heartgold: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
flavor_text.pearl: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
flavor_text.platinum: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.
flavor_text.red: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.
flavor_text.ruby: GLOOM releases a foul fragrance from the pistil of its flower. When faced with danger, the stench worsens. If this POKéMON is feeling calm and secure, it does not release its usual stinky aroma.
flavor_text.sapphire: From its mouth GLOOM drips honey that smells absolutely horrible. Apparently, it loves the horrid stench. It sniffs the noxious fumes and then drools even more of its honey.
flavor_text.silver: It secretes a sticky, drool-like honey. Although sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It secretes a sticky, drool-like honey. Although sweet, it smells too repulsive to get very close.
flavor_text.yellow: Smells incredibly foul! However, around 1 out of 1,000 people enjoy sniffing its nose- bending stink.

flavor_text.blue: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
flavor_text.crystal: By shaking its big petals, it scat ters toxic pollen into the air, turning the air yellow.
flavor_text.diamond: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
flavor_text.emerald: In seasons when it produces more pollen, the air around a VILEPLUME turns yellow with the powder as it walks. The pollen is highly toxic and causes paralysis.
flavor_text.firered: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.
flavor_text.gold: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
flavor_text.heartgold: It has the world’s largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
flavor_text.pearl: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
flavor_text.platinum: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.
flavor_text.red: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
flavor_text.ruby: VILEPLUME’s toxic pollen triggers atrocious allergy attacks. That’s why it is advisable never to approach any attractive flowers in a jungle, however pretty they may be.
flavor_text.sapphire: VILEPLUME has the world’s largest petals. They are used to attract prey that are then doused with toxic spores. Once the prey are immobilized, this POKéMON catches and devours them.
flavor_text.silver: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poi sonous pollen.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.
flavor_text.yellow: Flaps its broad flower petals to scatter its poisonous pollen. The flapping sound is very loud.

flavor_text.blue: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw ing nutrients from the bug host.
flavor_text.crystal: The tochukaso growing on this POKéMON's back orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.
flavor_text.diamond: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
flavor_text.emerald: A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.
flavor_text.firered: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
flavor_text.gold: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.
flavor_text.pearl: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
flavor_text.platinum: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.
flavor_text.red: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by draw ing nutrients from the bug host.
flavor_text.ruby: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from the BUG POKéMON host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
flavor_text.sapphire: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this BUG POKéMON host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.
flavor_text.silver: As its body grows large, oriental mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.
flavor_text.soulsilver: As its body grows, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.
flavor_text.yellow: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

flavor_text.blue: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
flavor_text.crystal: When nothing's left to extract from the bug, the mushrooms on its back leave spores on the bug's egg.
flavor_text.diamond: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavor_text.emerald: PARASECT are known to infest the roots of large trees en masse and drain nutrients. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
flavor_text.firered: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.
flavor_text.gold: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mush rooms on its back.
flavor_text.heartgold: It stays mostly in dark, damp places, the preference not of the bug, but of the big mushroom on its back.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
flavor_text.pearl: It is controlled by a mushroom grown larger than the bug body. It is said to prefer damp places.
flavor_text.platinum: A mushroom grown larger than the host’s body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.
flavor_text.red: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.
flavor_text.ruby: PARASECT is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
flavor_text.sapphire: PARASECT is known to infest large trees en masse and drain nutrients from the lower trunk and roots. When an infested tree dies, they move onto another tree all at once.
flavor_text.silver: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mush room spores it scatters.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The larger the mushroom on its back grows, the stronger the mushroom spores it scatters.
flavor_text.yellow: The bug host is drained of energy by the mushrooms on its back. They appear to do all the thinking.

flavor_text.blue: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
flavor_text.crystal: The small bugs it eats appear only at night, so it sleeps in a hole in a tree until night falls.
flavor_text.diamond: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavor_text.emerald: Its coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body is said to have evolved for protection. Its large eyes never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
flavor_text.firered: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.
flavor_text.gold: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its eyes also function as radar units. It catches and eats small bugs that hide in darkness.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.
flavor_text.pearl: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavor_text.platinum: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
flavor_text.red: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.
flavor_text.ruby: VENONAT is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
flavor_text.sapphire: VENONAT is said to have evolved with a coat of thin, stiff hair that covers its entire body for protection. It possesses large eyes that never fail to spot even miniscule prey.
flavor_text.silver: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are at tracted by light.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.
flavor_text.yellow: Its large eyes act as radars. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.

flavor_text.blue: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
flavor_text.crystal: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
flavor_text.diamond: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavor_text.emerald: VENOMOTH are nocturnal--they only are active at night. Their favorite prey are insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
flavor_text.firered: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
flavor_text.gold: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poi sonous powder all around.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it attacks, it flaps its large wings violently to scatter its poisonous powder all around.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
flavor_text.pearl: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavor_text.platinum: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.
flavor_text.red: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.
flavor_text.ruby: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
flavor_text.sapphire: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON that only becomes active at night. Its favorite prey are small insects that gather around streetlights, attracted by the light in the darkness.
flavor_text.silver: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in color. If it is light, it causes paralysis.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.
flavor_text.yellow: The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.

flavor_text.blue: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
flavor_text.crystal: It digs under ground and chews on tree roots, sticking its head out only when the sun isn't bright.
flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavor_text.emerald: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple--wherever they burrow, the soil is left perfectly tilled for growing delicious crops.
flavor_text.firered: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
flavor_text.gold: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavor_text.platinum: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.
flavor_text.red: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.
flavor_text.ruby: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple - wherever this POKéMON burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
flavor_text.sapphire: DIGLETT are raised in most farms. The reason is simple - wherever this POKéMON burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
flavor_text.silver: If a DIGLETT DIGS through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If a DIGLETT digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
flavor_text.yellow: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.

flavor_text.blue: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
flavor_text.crystal: These DIGLETT triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
flavor_text.diamond: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavor_text.emerald: Because the triplets originally split from one body, they think exactly alike. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly through the ground.
flavor_text.firered: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
flavor_text.gold: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
flavor_text.pearl: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavor_text.platinum: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.
flavor_text.red: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
flavor_text.ruby: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
flavor_text.sapphire: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
flavor_text.silver: Extremely power ful, they can DIG through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.
flavor_text.yellow: A team of triplets that can burrow over 60 MPH. Due to this, some people think it's an earthquake.

flavor_text.blue: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
flavor_text.crystal: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.
flavor_text.diamond: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavor_text.emerald: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
flavor_text.firered: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
flavor_text.gold: It is fascinated by round objects. It can't stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is fascinated by round objects. It can’t stop playing with them until it tires and falls asleep.
