flavor_text.leafgreen: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
flavor_text.pearl: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavor_text.platinum: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
flavor_text.red: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
flavor_text.ruby: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
flavor_text.sapphire: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
flavor_text.silver: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and se cretly hoards.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.
flavor_text.yellow: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop from picking them up.

flavor_text.blue: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
flavor_text.crystal: Behind its lithe, elegant appearance lies a barbaric side. It will tear apart its prey on a mere whim.
flavor_text.diamond: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavor_text.emerald: A PERSIAN’s six bold whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in its vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
flavor_text.firered: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
flavor_text.gold: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
flavor_text.heartgold: Many adore it for its sophisticated air. However, it will lash out and scratch for little reason.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
flavor_text.pearl: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavor_text.platinum: A very haughty Pokémon. Among fans, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.
flavor_text.red: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
flavor_text.ruby: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the POKéMON’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
flavor_text.sapphire: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the POKéMON’s surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
flavor_text.silver: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.
flavor_text.yellow: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.

flavor_text.blue: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
flavor_text.crystal: The only time it can use its psy chic power is when its sleeping brain cells happen to wake.
flavor_text.diamond: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
flavor_text.emerald: When its headache intensifies, it starts using strange powers. However, it has no recollection of its powers, so it always looks befuddled and bewildered.
flavor_text.firered: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
flavor_text.gold: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
flavor_text.heartgold: It has mystical powers but doesn’t recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.
flavor_text.leafgreen: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
flavor_text.pearl: It never remembers using its odd powers, so it always tilts its head in puzzlement.
flavor_text.platinum: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.
flavor_text.red: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.
flavor_text.ruby: PSYDUCK uses a mysterious power. When it does so, this POKéMON generates brain waves that are supposedly only seen in sleepers. This discovery spurred controversy among scholars.
flavor_text.sapphire: If it uses its mysterious power, PSYDUCK can’t remember having done so. It apparently can’t form a memory of such an event because it goes into an altered state that is much like deep sleep.
flavor_text.silver: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.
flavor_text.yellow: Always tormented by headaches. It uses psychic powers, but it is not known if it intends to do so.

flavor_text.blue: Often seen swim ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
flavor_text.crystal: It swims grace fully along on the quiet, slow-moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.
flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
flavor_text.emerald: A GOLDUCK is an adept swimmer. It sometimes joins competitive swimmers in training. It uses psychic powers when its forehead shimmers with light.
flavor_text.firered: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.
flavor_text.gold: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its fore head somehow be gins to glow.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.
flavor_text.pearl: The flippers of its well-developed limbs give it shocking speed. It is the best swimmer among Pokémon.
flavor_text.platinum: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.
flavor_text.red: Often seen swim ming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.
flavor_text.ruby: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and hind legs and the streamlined body of GOLDUCK give it frightening speed. This POKéMON is definitely much faster than even the most athletic swimmer.
flavor_text.sapphire: GOLDUCK is the fastest swimmer among all POKéMON. It swims effortlessly, even in a rough, stormy sea. It sometimes rescues people from wrecked ships floundering in high seas.
flavor_text.silver: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use tele kinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It appears by waterways at dusk. It may use telekinetic powers if its forehead glows mysteriously.
flavor_text.yellow: Its slim and long limbs end in broad flippers. They are used for swim ming gracefully in lakes.

flavor_text.blue: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
flavor_text.crystal: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
flavor_text.diamond: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavor_text.emerald: When it starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign of anger. However, since this happens instantly, there is no time to flee.
flavor_text.firered: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
flavor_text.gold: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavor_text.platinum: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.
flavor_text.red: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.
flavor_text.ruby: When MANKEY starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
flavor_text.sapphire: When MANKEY starts shaking and its nasal breathing turns rough, it’s a sure sign that it is becoming angry. However, because it goes into a towering rage almost instantly, it is impossible for anyone to flee its wrath.
flavor_text.silver: It's unsafe to ap proach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can't distinguish friends from foes.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It’s unsafe to approach if it gets violently enraged for no reason and can’t distinguish friends from foes.
flavor_text.yellow: An agile POKéMON that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

flavor_text.blue: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
flavor_text.crystal: It will beat up anyone who makes it mad, even if it has to chase them until the end of the world.
flavor_text.diamond: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavor_text.emerald: When it becomes furious, its blood circulation becomes more robust, and its muscles are made stronger. But it also becomes much less intelligent.
flavor_text.firered: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.
flavor_text.gold: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
flavor_text.heartgold: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.
flavor_text.pearl: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavor_text.platinum: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.
flavor_text.red: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.
flavor_text.ruby: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
flavor_text.sapphire: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its blood circulation is boosted. In turn, its muscles are made even stronger. However, it also becomes much less intelligent at the same time.
flavor_text.silver: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.
flavor_text.yellow: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

flavor_text.blue: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
flavor_text.crystal: It controls a big territory. If it detects an unknown smell, it roars loudly to force out the intruder.
flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
flavor_text.emerald: Its superb sense of smell ensures that this POKéMON won’t forget any scent, no matter what. It uses its sense of smell to detect the emotions of others.
flavor_text.firered: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
flavor_text.gold: It has a brave and trustworthy na ture. It fear lessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
flavor_text.heartgold: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
flavor_text.platinum: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
flavor_text.red: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.
flavor_text.ruby: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this POKéMON won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
flavor_text.sapphire: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this POKéMON won’t forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
flavor_text.silver: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any oppo nent to protect its own trainer from harm.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
flavor_text.yellow: A POKéMON with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.

flavor_text.blue: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
flavor_text.crystal: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were attracted to its movement as it ran through prairies.
flavor_text.diamond: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
flavor_text.emerald: This fleet-footed POKéMON is said to run over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within its body is its source of power.
flavor_text.firered: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.
flavor_text.gold: This legendary Chinese POKEMON is considered magnif icent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
flavor_text.heartgold: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is considered magnificent. Many people are enchanted by its grand mane.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A POKéMON that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
flavor_text.pearl: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
flavor_text.platinum: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.
flavor_text.red: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
flavor_text.ruby: ARCANINE is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this POKéMON’s body is its source of power.
flavor_text.sapphire: ARCANINE is known for its high speed. It is said to be capable of running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night. The fire that blazes wildly within this POKéMON’s body is its source of power.
flavor_text.silver: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can't help but grovel before it.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its magnificent bark conveys a sense of majesty. Anyone hearing it can’t help but grovel before it.
flavor_text.yellow: A legendary POKé MON in China. Many people are charmed by its grace and beauty while running.

flavor_text.blue: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
flavor_text.crystal: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.
flavor_text.diamond: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavor_text.emerald: It is possible to see this POKéMON’s spiral innards right through its thin skin. However, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
flavor_text.firered: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
flavor_text.gold: Because it is in ept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
flavor_text.heartgold: Because it is inept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.
flavor_text.pearl: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavor_text.platinum: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.
flavor_text.red: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
flavor_text.ruby: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the POKéMON’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
flavor_text.sapphire: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the POKéMON’s spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
flavor_text.silver: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.
flavor_text.yellow: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.

flavor_text.blue: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
flavor_text.crystal: Though it is skilled at walk ing, it prefers to live underwater where there is less danger.
flavor_text.diamond: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavor_text.emerald: Its body surface is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
flavor_text.firered: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.
flavor_text.gold: The swirl on its belly subtly un dulates. Staring at it may gradual ly cause drowsi ness.
flavor_text.heartgold: The swirl on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it may gradually cause drowsiness.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.
flavor_text.pearl: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavor_text.platinum: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.
flavor_text.red: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.
flavor_text.ruby: The surface of POLIWHIRL’s body is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
flavor_text.sapphire: The surface of POLIWHIRL’s body is always wet and slick with an oily fluid. Because of this greasy covering, it can easily slip and slide out of the clutches of any enemy in battle.
flavor_text.silver: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.
flavor_text.yellow: Under attack, it uses its belly spiral to put the foe to sleep. It then makes its escape.

flavor_text.blue: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
flavor_text.crystal: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
flavor_text.diamond: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavor_text.emerald: Its highly developed muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. This POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
flavor_text.firered: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.
flavor_text.gold: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
flavor_text.heartgold: This strong and skilled swimmer is even capable of crossing the Pacific Ocean just by kicking.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
flavor_text.pearl: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavor_text.platinum: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.
flavor_text.red: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.
flavor_text.ruby: POLIWRATH’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
flavor_text.sapphire: POLIWRATH’s highly developed, brawny muscles never grow fatigued, however much it exercises. It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON can swim back and forth across the Pacific Ocean without effort.
flavor_text.silver: Although an ener getic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its mus cles, it lives on dry land.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.
flavor_text.yellow: Swims powerfully using all the muscles in its body. It can even overtake champion swimmers.

flavor_text.blue: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
flavor_text.crystal: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.
flavor_text.diamond: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
flavor_text.emerald: A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.
flavor_text.firered: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
flavor_text.gold: It senses impend ing attacks and TELEPORTS away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
flavor_text.heartgold: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
flavor_text.pearl: Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar. It teleports when it is threatened.
flavor_text.platinum: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
flavor_text.red: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.
flavor_text.ruby: ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this POKéMON immediately teleports to safety.
flavor_text.sapphire: ABRA needs to sleep for eighteen hours a day. If it doesn’t, this POKéMON loses its ability to use telekinetic powers. If it is attacked, ABRA escapes using TELEPORT while it is still sleeping.
flavor_text.silver: If it decides to TELEPORT randomly, it creates the illusion that it has created copies of itself.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If it decides to teleport randomly, it evokes the illusion that it has created copies of itself.
flavor_text.yellow: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

flavor_text.blue: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
flavor_text.crystal: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti cles come out of the surface of its body.
flavor_text.diamond: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
flavor_text.emerald: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into KADABRA while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
flavor_text.firered: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.
flavor_text.gold: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
flavor_text.heartgold: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.
flavor_text.pearl: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong ha waves that can ruin precision devices.
flavor_text.platinum: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
flavor_text.red: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
flavor_text.ruby: KADABRA emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a TRAINER of this POKéMON.
flavor_text.sapphire: KADABRA holds a silver spoon in its hand. The spoon is used to amplify the alpha waves in its brain. Without the spoon, the POKéMON is said to be limited to half the usual amount of its telekinetic powers.
flavor_text.silver: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.
flavor_text.yellow: Many odd things happen if this POKéMON is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backwards.

flavor_text.blue: Its brain can out perform a super computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
flavor_text.crystal: It has an IQ of 5000. It calcu lates many things in order to gain the edge in every battle.
flavor_text.diamond: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.
flavor_text.emerald: While it has strong psychic abilities and high intelligence, an ALAKAZAM’s muscles are very weak. It uses psychic power to move its body.
flavor_text.firered: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra sensory powers to defeat foes.
flavor_text.gold: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
flavor_text.heartgold: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses. This enables it to use its abilities to their extremes.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.
flavor_text.pearl: Its highly developed brain is on par with a supercomputer. It can use all forms of psychic abilities.
flavor_text.platinum: The spoons clutched in its hands are said to have been created by its psychic powers.
flavor_text.red: Its brain can out perform a super computer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.
flavor_text.ruby: ALAKAZAM’s brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This POKéMON holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
flavor_text.sapphire: ALAKAZAM’s brain continually grows, infinitely multiplying brain cells. This amazing brain gives this POKéMON an astoundingly high IQ of 5,000. It has a thorough memory of everything that has occurred in the world.
flavor_text.silver: Its brain cells multiply continu ally until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
flavor_text.yellow: A POKéMON that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns-- that's why this POKéMON is smart.

flavor_text.blue: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
flavor_text.crystal: It trains by lifting rocks in the mountains. It can even pick up a GRAVELER with ease.
flavor_text.diamond: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
flavor_text.emerald: It continually undertakes strenuous training to master all forms of martial arts. Its strength lets it easily hoist a sumo wrestler onto its shoulders.
flavor_text.firered: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
flavor_text.gold: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
flavor_text.heartgold: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
flavor_text.pearl: Its muscles never cramp however much it trains. It lives in the mountains away from humans.
flavor_text.platinum: Though small in stature, it is powerful enough to easily heft and throw a number of GEODUDE at once.
flavor_text.red: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.
flavor_text.ruby: MACHOP’s muscles are special - they never get sore no matter how much they are used in exercise. This POKéMON has sufficient power to hurl a hundred adult humans.
flavor_text.sapphire: MACHOP exercises by hefting around a GRAVELER as if it were a barbell. There are some MACHOP that travel the world in a quest to master all kinds of martial arts.
flavor_text.silver: It loves to work out and build its muscles. It is never satisfied, even if it trains hard all day long.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It loves to work out and build its muscles. It is never satisfied, even if it trains hard all day long.
flavor_text.yellow: Very powerful in spite of its small size. Its mastery of many types of martial arts makes it very tough.

flavor_text.blue: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavor_text.crystal: This tough POKéMON always stays in the zone. Its muscles become thicker after every battle.
flavor_text.diamond: MACHOKE’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
flavor_text.emerald: A belt is worn by a MACHOKE to keep its overwhelming power under control. Because it is so dangerous, no one has ever removed the belt.
flavor_text.firered: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
flavor_text.gold: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable POKéMON never gets tired.
flavor_text.heartgold: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavor_text.pearl: It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that power, it helps people with heavy jobs.
flavor_text.platinum: It happily carries heavy cargo to toughen up. It willingly does hard work for people.
flavor_text.red: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
flavor_text.ruby: MACHOKE’s thoroughly toned muscles possess the hardness of steel. This POKéMON has so much strength, it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler on just one finger.
flavor_text.sapphire: MACHOKE undertakes bodybuilding every day even as it helps people with tough, physically demanding labor. On its days off, this POKéMON heads to the fields and mountains to exercise and train.
flavor_text.silver: The muscles cover ing its body teem with power. Even when still, it exudes an amazing sense of strength.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The muscles covering its body teem with power. Even when still, it exudes an amazing sense of strength.
flavor_text.yellow: The belt around its waist holds back its energy. Without it, this POKéMON would be unstoppable.

flavor_text.blue: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
flavor_text.crystal: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.
flavor_text.diamond: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
flavor_text.emerald: It is impossible to defend against punches and chops doled out by its four arms. Its fighting spirit flares up when it faces a tough opponent.
flavor_text.firered: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
flavor_text.gold: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
flavor_text.heartgold: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its superpowerful punches are said to knock the victim flying clear over the horizon.
flavor_text.pearl: It can knock a train flying with a punch. However, it is terrible at delicate work using its fingers.
flavor_text.platinum: Its four muscled arms slam foes with powerful punches and chops at blinding speed.
flavor_text.red: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.
flavor_text.ruby: MACHAMP has the power to hurl anything aside. However, trying to do any work requiring care and dexterity causes its arms to get tangled. This POKéMON tends to leap into action before it thinks.
flavor_text.sapphire: MACHAMP is known as the POKéMON that has mastered every kind of martial arts. If it grabs hold of the foe with its four arms, the battle is all but over. The hapless foe is thrown far over the horizon.
flavor_text.silver: It uses its four powerful arms to pin the limbs of its foe, then throws the victim over the horizon.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It uses its four powerful arms to pin the limbs of its foe, then throws the victim over the horizon.
flavor_text.yellow: One arm alone can move mountains. Using all four arms, this POKéMON fires off awesome punches.

flavor_text.blue: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
flavor_text.crystal: If it notices anything that moves, it immediately flings its vine at the object.
flavor_text.diamond: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavor_text.emerald: A BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, it leaks a fluid that melts even iron.
flavor_text.firered: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.
flavor_text.gold: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavor_text.heartgold: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It appears to use its root feet to replenish moisture.
flavor_text.pearl: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavor_text.platinum: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.
flavor_text.red: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.
flavor_text.ruby: BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this POKéMON spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
flavor_text.sapphire: BELLSPROUT’s thin and flexible body lets it bend and sway to avoid any attack, however strong it may be. From its mouth, this POKéMON spits a corrosive fluid that melts even iron.
flavor_text.silver: It plants its feet deep underground to replenish wa ter. It can't es cape its enemy while it's rooted.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It plants its feet deep underground to replenish water. It can’t escape its enemy while it’s rooted.
flavor_text.yellow: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny insects with its vines and devours them.

flavor_text.blue: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
flavor_text.crystal: When it's hungry, it swings its razor-sharp leaves, slicing up any unlucky object nearby for food.
flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavor_text.emerald: At night, a WEEPINBELL hangs on to a tree branch with its hooked rear and sleeps. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
flavor_text.firered: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
flavor_text.gold: Even though it is filled with ACID, it does not melt because it also oozes a neutral izing fluid.
flavor_text.heartgold: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavor_text.platinum: A Pokémon that appears to be a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.
flavor_text.red: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.
flavor_text.ruby: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
flavor_text.sapphire: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear end. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to a tree branch and goes to sleep. If it moves around in its sleep, it may wake up to find itself on the ground.
flavor_text.silver: If its prey is bigger than its mouth, it slices up the victim with sharp leaves, then eats every morsel.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If its prey is bigger than its mouth, it slices up the victim with sharp leaves, then eats every morsel.
flavor_text.yellow: When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is melted inside by strong acids.

flavor_text.blue: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
flavor_text.crystal: Once ingested into this POKéMON's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.
flavor_text.diamond: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavor_text.emerald: The long vine extending from its head is waved about as if it were a living thing to attract prey. When an unsuspecting victim approaches, it is swallowed whole.
flavor_text.firered: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.
flavor_text.gold: ACID that has dis solved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
flavor_text.heartgold: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
flavor_text.pearl: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavor_text.platinum: It pools in its mouth a fluid with a honeylike scent, which is really an acid that dissolves anything.
flavor_text.red: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
flavor_text.ruby: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this POKéMON swallows it whole.
flavor_text.sapphire: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that extends from its head. This vine is waved and flicked about as if it were an animal to attract prey. When an unsuspecting prey draws near, this POKéMON swallows it whole.
flavor_text.silver: This horrifying plant POKéMON at tracts prey with aromatic honey, then melts them in its mouth.
flavor_text.soulsilver: This horrifying plant Pokémon attracts prey with aromatic honey, then melts them in its mouth.
flavor_text.yellow: Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is melted in a day, bones and all.

flavor_text.blue: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
flavor_text.crystal: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.
flavor_text.diamond: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
flavor_text.emerald: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
flavor_text.firered: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.
flavor_text.gold: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
flavor_text.heartgold: When the tide goes out, dehydrated TENTACOOL remains can be found washed up on the shore.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.
flavor_text.pearl: It drifts in sea currents. Countless fishermen are hurt by its poison stingers.
flavor_text.platinum: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.
flavor_text.red: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
flavor_text.ruby: TENTACOOL’s body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this POKéMON happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
flavor_text.sapphire: TENTACOOL absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. This POKéMON shoots beams from its crystal-like eyes.
flavor_text.silver: It drifts aimless ly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
flavor_text.yellow: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.

flavor_text.blue: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
flavor_text.crystal: When its 80 feel ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.
flavor_text.diamond: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
flavor_text.emerald: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
flavor_text.firered: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
flavor_text.gold: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to CON STRICT its prey and enemies.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to constrict its prey and enemies.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
flavor_text.pearl: It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.
flavor_text.platinum: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.
flavor_text.red: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
flavor_text.ruby: TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This POKéMON’s outburst creates rough waves around it.
flavor_text.sapphire: TENTACRUEL has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.
flavor_text.silver: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its oppo nent inside a poisonous net.
flavor_text.soulsilver: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.
flavor_text.yellow: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.

flavor_text.blue: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
flavor_text.crystal: Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.
flavor_text.diamond: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
flavor_text.emerald: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
flavor_text.firered: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.
flavor_text.gold: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
flavor_text.heartgold: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many GEODUDE around.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
flavor_text.pearl: It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams against others in contests of hardness.
flavor_text.platinum: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.
flavor_text.red: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
flavor_text.ruby: The longer a GEODUDE lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this POKéMON’s heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
flavor_text.sapphire: When GEODUDE sleeps deeply, it buries itself halfway into the ground. It will not awaken even if hikers step on it unwittingly. In the morning, this POKéMON rolls downhill in search of food.
flavor_text.silver: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.
flavor_text.yellow: Commonly found near mountain trails, etc. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.

flavor_text.blue: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
flavor_text.crystal: It travels by rol ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.
flavor_text.diamond: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
flavor_text.emerald: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
flavor_text.firered: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.
flavor_text.gold: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
flavor_text.heartgold: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn’t mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
flavor_text.pearl: It tumbles down slopes, heedless of any body parts chipping off. It eats a ton of rocks daily.
flavor_text.platinum: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokémon can stop it without difficulty.
flavor_text.red: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
flavor_text.ruby: GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This POKéMON eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
flavor_text.sapphire: Rocks are GRAVELER’s favorite food. This POKéMON will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.
flavor_text.silver: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.
flavor_text.yellow: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

flavor_text.blue: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
flavor_text.crystal: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.
flavor_text.diamond: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
flavor_text.emerald: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
flavor_text.firered: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
flavor_text.gold: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hard ens and crumbles away.
flavor_text.heartgold: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hardens and crumbles away.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.
flavor_text.pearl: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
flavor_text.platinum: Even dynamite can’t harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
flavor_text.red: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
flavor_text.ruby: GOLEM live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these POKéMON will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
flavor_text.sapphire: GOLEM is known for rolling down from mountains. To prevent them from rolling into the homes of people downhill, grooves have been dug into the sides of mountains to serve as guideways for diverting this POKéMON’s course.
flavor_text.silver: It is capable of blowing itself up. It uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is capable of blowing itself up. It uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.
flavor_text.yellow: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.

flavor_text.blue: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
flavor_text.crystal: Training by jumping over grass that grows longer every day has made it a world-class jumper.
flavor_text.diamond: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.
flavor_text.emerald: A PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. Its legs become stronger as it stumbles and falls while trying to keep up with its parent.
flavor_text.firered: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.
flavor_text.gold: It is a weak run ner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its hooves are ten times harder than diamond. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
flavor_text.pearl: Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.
flavor_text.platinum: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.
flavor_text.red: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.
flavor_text.ruby: PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This POKéMON becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
flavor_text.sapphire: PONYTA is very weak at birth. It can barely stand up. This POKéMON becomes stronger by stumbling and falling to keep up with its parent.
flavor_text.silver: Its hind legs, which have hard er-than-diamond hooves, kick back at any presence it senses behind it.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its hind legs, which have hooves that are harder than diamond, kick back at any presence it senses behind it.
flavor_text.yellow: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.

flavor_text.blue: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
flavor_text.crystal: It just loves to gallop. The faster it goes, the long er the swaying flames of its mane will become.
flavor_text.diamond: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
flavor_text.emerald: It usually canters casually in the fields and plains. But once a RAPIDASH turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
flavor_text.firered: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.
flavor_text.gold: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredi bly fast.
flavor_text.heartgold: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
flavor_text.pearl: It has astounding acceleration. From a standstill, it can reach top speed within 10 steps.
flavor_text.platinum: When at an all-out gallop, its blazing mane sparkles, enhancing its beautiful appearance.
flavor_text.red: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.
flavor_text.ruby: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this POKéMON turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
flavor_text.sapphire: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually cantering in the fields and plains. However, when this POKéMON turns serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze as it gallops its way up to 150 mph.
flavor_text.silver: With incredible acceleration, it reaches its top speed of 150 mph after running just ten steps.
flavor_text.soulsilver: With incredible acceleration, it reaches its top speed of 150 mph after running just 10 steps.
flavor_text.yellow: Just loves to run. If it sees some thing faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.

flavor_text.blue: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
flavor_text.crystal: It is always so absent-minded that it won't react, even if its flavorful tail is bitten.
flavor_text.diamond: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavor_text.emerald: It catches prey by dipping its tail in water at the side of a river. But it often forgets what it is doing and spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
flavor_text.firered: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
flavor_text.gold: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
flavor_text.heartgold: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
flavor_text.pearl: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavor_text.platinum: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.
flavor_text.red: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
flavor_text.ruby: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this POKéMON often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
flavor_text.sapphire: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by dipping it in water at the side of a river. However, this POKéMON often forgets what it’s doing and often spends entire days just loafing at water’s edge.
flavor_text.silver: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A sweet sap leaks from its tail’s tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.
flavor_text.yellow: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.

flavor_text.blue: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
flavor_text.crystal: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.
flavor_text.diamond: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
flavor_text.emerald: Its tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This forces it to reluctantly swim and catch prey.
flavor_text.firered: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.
flavor_text.gold: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordi nary SLOWPOKE.
flavor_text.heartgold: If the tail-biting SHELLDER is thrown off in a harsh battle, it reverts to being an ordinary SLOWPOKE.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The SHELLDER that latches onto SLOWPOKE’s tail is said to feed on the host’s leftover scraps.
flavor_text.pearl: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
flavor_text.platinum: Though usually dim witted, it seems to become inspired if the SHELLDER on its tail bites down.
flavor_text.red: The SHELLDER that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.
flavor_text.ruby: SLOWBRO’s tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
flavor_text.sapphire: SLOWBRO’s tail has a SHELLDER firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can’t be used for fishing anymore. This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
flavor_text.silver: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to SHELLDER's seeping poison.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to SHELLDER’s seeping poison.
flavor_text.yellow: Lives lazily by the sea. If the SHELLDER on its tail comes off, it becomes a SLOWPOKE again.

flavor_text.blue: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
flavor_text.crystal: The electricity emitted by the units on each side of its body cause it to become a strong magnet.
flavor_text.diamond: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.
flavor_text.emerald: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.
flavor_text.firered: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.
flavor_text.gold: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach trainers if they are using their POKéGEAR.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach Trainers if they are using their Pokégear.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
flavor_text.pearl: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.
flavor_text.platinum: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.
flavor_text.red: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.
flavor_text.ruby: MAGNEMITE attaches itself to power lines to feed on electricity. If your house has a power outage, check your circuit breakers. You may find a large number of this POKéMON clinging to the breaker box.
flavor_text.sapphire: MAGNEMITE floats in the air by emitting electromagnetic waves from the units at its sides. These waves block gravity. This POKéMON becomes incapable of flight if its internal electrical supply is depleted.
flavor_text.silver: The units at the sides of its body generate anti gravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.
flavor_text.yellow: It is born with the ability to defy gravity. It floats in air on powerful electro magnetic waves.

flavor_text.blue: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
flavor_text.crystal: When many MAGNETON gather together, the resulting magnetic storm disrupts radio waves.
flavor_text.diamond: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.
flavor_text.emerald: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. It generates powerful radio waves that raise temperatures by 3.6 degrees F within a 3,300-foot radius.
flavor_text.firered: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
flavor_text.gold: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
flavor_text.heartgold: Three MAGNEMITE are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
flavor_text.pearl: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.
flavor_text.platinum: Many mysteriously appear when more sunspots dot the sun. They stop TV sets from displaying properly.
flavor_text.red: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.
flavor_text.ruby: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to mechanical devices. As a result, large cities sound sirens to warn citizens of large-scale outbreaks of this POKéMON.
flavor_text.sapphire: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic force that is fatal to electronics and precision instruments. Because of this, it is said that some towns warn people to keep this POKéMON inside a POKé BALL.
flavor_text.silver: The MAGNEMITE are united by a mag netism so power ful, it dries all moisture in its vicinities.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The MAGNEMITE are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.
flavor_text.yellow: Generates strange radio signals. It raises the tem perature by 3.6F degrees within 3,300 feet.

flavor_text.blue: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
flavor_text.crystal: In order to pre vent their extinction, more people have made an effort to breed these POKéMON.
flavor_text.diamond: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavor_text.emerald: It is always seen with a stick from a plant. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON occasionally fights with others over choice sticks.
flavor_text.firered: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
flavor_text.gold: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant sticks grow, it uses its own stick to thwart them.
flavor_text.heartgold: If anyone tries to disturb where the essential plant stalks grow, it uses its own stalk to thwart them.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.
flavor_text.pearl: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavor_text.platinum: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.
flavor_text.red: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.
flavor_text.ruby: FARFETCH’D is always seen with a stick from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON has been known to fight with others over sticks.
flavor_text.sapphire: FARFETCH’D is always seen with a stick from a plant of some sort. Apparently, there are good sticks and bad sticks. This POKéMON has been known to fight with others over sticks.
flavor_text.silver: If it eats the plant stick it carries as emer gency rations, it runs off in search of a new stick.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.
flavor_text.yellow: Lives where reedy plants grow. They are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.

flavor_text.blue: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
flavor_text.crystal: It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.
flavor_text.diamond: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavor_text.emerald: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.
flavor_text.firered: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
flavor_text.gold: By alternately raising and lower ing its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
flavor_text.heartgold: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
flavor_text.pearl: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavor_text.platinum: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
flavor_text.red: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.
flavor_text.ruby: DODUO’s two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.
flavor_text.sapphire: DODUO’s two heads contain completely identical brains. A scientific study reported that on rare occasions, there will be examples of this POKéMON possessing different sets of brains.
flavor_text.silver: It races through grassy plains with powerful strides, leaving footprints up to four inches deep.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It races through grassy plains with powerful strides, leaving footprints up to four inches deep.
flavor_text.yellow: Its short wings make flying dif ficult. Instead, this POKéMON runs at high speed on developed legs.

flavor_text.blue: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
flavor_text.crystal: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads--even for a second--will get pecked severely.
flavor_text.diamond: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavor_text.emerald: A peculiar POKéMON species with three heads. It vigorously races across grassy plains even in arid seasons with little rainfall.
flavor_text.firered: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.
flavor_text.gold: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and be come immobilized.
flavor_text.heartgold: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head is said to stay awake.
flavor_text.pearl: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavor_text.platinum: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.
flavor_text.red: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.
flavor_text.ruby: Watch out if DODRIO’s three heads are looking in three separate directions. It’s a sure sign that it is on its guard. Don’t go near this POKéMON if it’s being wary - it may decide to peck you.
flavor_text.sapphire: Apparently, the heads aren’t the only parts of the body that DODRIO has three of. It has three sets of hearts and lungs as well, so it is capable of running long distances without rest.
flavor_text.silver: If one of the heads gets to eat, the others will be satisfied, too, and they will stop squabbling.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If one of the heads gets to eat, the others will be satisfied, too, and they will stop squabbling.
flavor_text.yellow: One of DODUO's 2 heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 MPH in prairies.

flavor_text.blue: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
flavor_text.crystal: The light blue fur that covers it keeps it protected against the cold. It loves iceberg- filled oceans.
flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavor_text.emerald: SEEL hunt for prey in frigid, ice-covered seas. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
flavor_text.firered: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor_text.gold: Although it can't walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It espe cially loves being in frigid seas.
flavor_text.heartgold: Although it can’t walk well on land, it is a graceful swimmer. It especially loves being in frigid seas.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavor_text.platinum: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.
flavor_text.red: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.
flavor_text.ruby: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
flavor_text.sapphire: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea underneath sheets of ice. When it needs to breathe, it punches a hole through the ice with the sharply protruding section of its head.
flavor_text.silver: In daytime, it is often found asleep on the seabed in shallow waters. Its nostrils close while it swims.
flavor_text.soulsilver: In daytime, it is often found asleep on the seabed in shallow waters. Its nostrils close while it swims.
flavor_text.yellow: Loves freezing cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid cli mate of around 14F degrees.

flavor_text.blue: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
flavor_text.crystal: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's cold.
flavor_text.diamond: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
flavor_text.emerald: It loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
flavor_text.firered: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
flavor_text.gold: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its streamlined body has little drag in water. The colder the temperature, the friskier it gets.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It stores thermal energy in the body. It swims at a steady eight knots even in intensely cold waters.
flavor_text.pearl: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
flavor_text.platinum: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.
flavor_text.red: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.
flavor_text.ruby: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
flavor_text.sapphire: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly cold ice. The sight of this POKéMON sleeping on a glacier was mistakenly thought to be a mermaid by a mariner long ago.
flavor_text.silver: It loves frigid seas with ice floes. It uses its long tail to change swimming direction quickly.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It loves frigid seas with ice floes. It uses its long tail to change swimming direction quickly.
flavor_text.yellow: Its entire body is a snowy-white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.

flavor_text.blue: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
flavor_text.crystal: When two of these POKéMON's bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.
flavor_text.diamond: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
flavor_text.emerald: Born from polluted sludge in the sea, GRIMER’s favorite food is anything filthy. They feed on wastewater pumped out from factories.
flavor_text.firered: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.
flavor_text.gold: As it moves, it loses bits of its body from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
flavor_text.heartgold: As it moves, it loses bits of its body, from which new GRIMER emerge. This worsens the stench around it.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
flavor_text.pearl: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
flavor_text.platinum: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.
flavor_text.red: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
flavor_text.ruby: GRIMER’s sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This POKéMON enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
flavor_text.sapphire: GRIMER emerged from the sludge that settled on a polluted seabed. This POKéMON loves anything filthy. It constantly leaks a horribly germ- infested fluid from all over its body.
flavor_text.silver: Wherever GRIMER has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Wherever GRIMER has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.
flavor_text.yellow: Made of hardened sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.

flavor_text.blue: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
flavor_text.crystal: As it moves, a very strong poison leaks from it, making the ground there barren for three years.
flavor_text.diamond: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
flavor_text.emerald: It prefers warm and humid habitats. In the summertime, the toxic substances in its body intensify, making MUK reek like putrid kitchen garbage.
flavor_text.firered: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.
flavor_text.gold: They love to gath er in smelly areas where sludge ac cumulates, making the stench around them worse.
flavor_text.heartgold: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
flavor_text.pearl: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
flavor_text.platinum: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
flavor_text.red: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
flavor_text.ruby: From MUK’s body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this POKéMON’s body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON’s favorite food is anything that is repugnantly filthy. In dirty towns where people think nothing of throwing away litter on the streets, MUK are certain to gather.
flavor_text.silver: Its body is made of a powerful poi son. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.
flavor_text.yellow: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration, it lost its sense of smell.

flavor_text.blue: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
flavor_text.crystal: Clamping on to an opponent reveals its vulnerable parts, so it uses this move only as a last resort.
flavor_text.diamond: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavor_text.emerald: At night, it burrows a hole in the seafloor with its broad tongue to make a place to sleep. While asleep, it closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
flavor_text.firered: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
flavor_text.gold: It swims facing backward by open ing and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
