flavor_text.heartgold: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
flavor_text.pearl: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavor_text.platinum: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.
flavor_text.red: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
flavor_text.ruby: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
flavor_text.sapphire: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad tongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor sand and then sleep in it. While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its shell, but leaves its tongue hanging out.
flavor_text.silver: Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Grains of sand trapped in its shells mix with its body fluids to form beautiful pearls.
flavor_text.yellow: The shell can withstand any attack. However, when it is open, the tender body is exposed.

flavor_text.blue: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
flavor_text.crystal: Even a missile can't break the spikes it uses to stab opponents. They're even hard er than its shell.
flavor_text.diamond: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavor_text.emerald: It swims in the sea by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. The CLOYSTER shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
flavor_text.firered: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
flavor_text.gold: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superi or strength.
flavor_text.heartgold: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
flavor_text.pearl: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavor_text.platinum: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.
flavor_text.red: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.
flavor_text.ruby: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This POKéMON shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
flavor_text.sapphire: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the sea. It does so by swallowing water, then jetting it out toward the rear. This POKéMON shoots spikes from its shell using the same system.
flavor_text.silver: CLOYSTER that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
flavor_text.soulsilver: CLOYSTER that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.
flavor_text.yellow: For protection, it uses its harder- than-diamonds shell. It also shoots spikes from the shell.

flavor_text.blue: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
flavor_text.crystal: It wraps its op ponent in its gas- like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
flavor_text.diamond: This Pokémon’s body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.
flavor_text.emerald: When exposed to a strong wind, a GASTLY’s gaseous body quickly dwindles away. They cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
flavor_text.firered: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.
flavor_text.gold: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
flavor_text.heartgold: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon born from poison gases. It defeats even the largest foes by enveloping them in gas.
flavor_text.platinum: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
flavor_text.red: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.
flavor_text.ruby: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this POKéMON cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
flavor_text.sapphire: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous matter. When exposed to a strong wind, the gaseous body quickly dwindles away. Groups of this POKéMON cluster under the eaves of houses to escape the ravages of wind.
flavor_text.silver: Its thin body is made of gas. It can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.
flavor_text.yellow: Said to appear in decrepit, deserted buildings. It has no real shape as it appears to be made of a gas.

flavor_text.blue: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an other dimension.
flavor_text.crystal: It hides in the dark, planning to take the life of the next living thing that wanders close by.
flavor_text.diamond: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
flavor_text.emerald: If a HAUNTER beckons you while it is floating in darkness, don’t approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
flavor_text.firered: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.
flavor_text.gold: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
flavor_text.heartgold: In total darkness, where nothing is visible, HAUNTER lurks, silently stalking its next victim.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.
flavor_text.pearl: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim’s life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.
flavor_text.platinum: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
flavor_text.red: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from an other dimension.
flavor_text.ruby: HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
flavor_text.sapphire: HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON. If one beckons you while floating in darkness, you must never approach it. This POKéMON will try to lick you with its tongue and steal your life away.
flavor_text.silver: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death even tually comes.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
flavor_text.yellow: By licking, it saps the victim's life. It causes shaking that won't stop until the victim's demise.

flavor_text.blue: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
flavor_text.crystal: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
flavor_text.diamond: It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.
flavor_text.emerald: Deep in the night, your shadow cast by a streetlight may suddenly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
flavor_text.firered: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.
flavor_text.gold: It steals heat from its surround ings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
flavor_text.heartgold: It steals heat from its surroundings. If you feel a sudden chill, it is certain that a GENGAR appeared.
flavor_text.leafgreen: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be GENGAR’s doing.
flavor_text.pearl: Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms, it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life force.
flavor_text.platinum: The leer that floats in darkness belongs to a GENGAR delighting in casting curses on people.
flavor_text.red: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.
flavor_text.ruby: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
flavor_text.sapphire: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a GENGAR running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
flavor_text.silver: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.
flavor_text.soulsilver: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.
flavor_text.yellow: A GENGAR is close by if you feel a sudden chill. It may be trying to lay a curse on you.

flavor_text.blue: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
flavor_text.crystal: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.
flavor_text.diamond: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
flavor_text.emerald: There is a magnet in its brain that prevents an ONIX from losing direction while tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes steadily rounder and smoother.
flavor_text.firered: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.
flavor_text.gold: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
flavor_text.heartgold: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.
flavor_text.leafgreen: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.
flavor_text.pearl: It squirms through the ground using its long and rugged body. It always eats while burrowing.
flavor_text.platinum: It burrows through the ground at a speed of 50 mph while feeding on large boulders.
flavor_text.red: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.
flavor_text.ruby: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this POKéMON does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
flavor_text.sapphire: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts as a compass so that this POKéMON does not lose direction while it is tunneling. As it grows older, its body becomes increasingly rounder and smoother.
flavor_text.silver: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its mas sive, rugged body.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
flavor_text.yellow: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by DIGLETTs.

flavor_text.blue: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
flavor_text.crystal: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.
flavor_text.diamond: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavor_text.emerald: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that a DROWZEE is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
flavor_text.firered: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.
flavor_text.gold: If you think that you had a good dream, but you can't remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
flavor_text.heartgold: If you think that you had a good dream but you can’t remember it, a DROWZEE has probably eaten it.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.
flavor_text.pearl: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavor_text.platinum: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.
flavor_text.red: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.
flavor_text.ruby: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these POKéMON is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
flavor_text.sapphire: If your nose becomes itchy while you are sleeping, it’s a sure sign that one of these POKéMON is standing above your pillow and trying to eat your dream through your nostrils.
flavor_text.silver: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children’s are much tastier.
flavor_text.yellow: If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it has eaten in the past.

flavor_text.blue: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
flavor_text.crystal: The longer it swings its pendulum, the longer the effects of its hypnosis last.
flavor_text.diamond: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavor_text.emerald: The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum in a HYPNO’s hand lull the foe into deep hypnosis. While searching for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
flavor_text.firered: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
flavor_text.gold: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it is very hungry, it puts humans it meets to sleep, then it feasts on their dreams.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
flavor_text.pearl: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavor_text.platinum: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.
flavor_text.red: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.
flavor_text.ruby: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this POKéMON searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
flavor_text.sapphire: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand. The arcing movement and glitter of the pendulum lull the foe into a deep state of hypnosis. While this POKéMON searches for prey, it polishes the pendulum.
flavor_text.silver: Always holding a pendulum that it rocks at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in any one nearby.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.
flavor_text.yellow: Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.

flavor_text.blue: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
flavor_text.crystal: If it is unable to find food, it will absorb nutrients by swallowing a mouthful of sand.
flavor_text.diamond: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavor_text.emerald: KRABBY live in holes dug into beaches. On sandy shores with little in the way of food, they can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
flavor_text.firered: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
flavor_text.gold: If it senses dan ger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
flavor_text.heartgold: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavor_text.platinum: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.
flavor_text.red: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.
flavor_text.ruby: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these POKéMON can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
flavor_text.sapphire: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside holes dug into the sand. On sandy beaches with little in the way of food, these POKéMON can be seen squabbling with each other over territory.
flavor_text.silver: The pincers break off easily. If it loses a pincer, it somehow becomes incapable of walk ing sideways.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The pincers break off easily. If it loses a pincer, it somehow becomes incapable of walking sideways.
flavor_text.yellow: Its pincers are superb weapons. They sometimes break off during battle, but they grow back fast.

flavor_text.blue: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
flavor_text.crystal: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
flavor_text.diamond: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavor_text.emerald: It waves its huge, oversized claw in the air to communicate with others. But since the claw is so heavy, this POKéMON quickly tires.
flavor_text.firered: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
flavor_text.gold: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer's size makes it difficult to aim properly.
flavor_text.heartgold: It can hardly lift its massive, overgrown pincer. The pincer’s size makes it difficult to aim properly.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower crushing force. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
flavor_text.pearl: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavor_text.platinum: The larger pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.
flavor_text.red: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.
flavor_text.ruby: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the POKéMON quickly tires.
flavor_text.sapphire: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized claw. It waves this huge claw in the air to communicate with others. However, because the claw is so heavy, the POKéMON quickly tires.
flavor_text.silver: Its pincers grow peculiarly large. If it lifts the pincers too fast, it loses its bal ance and staggers.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its pincers grow peculiarly large. If it lifts the pincers too fast, it loses its balance and staggers.
flavor_text.yellow: One claw grew massively and as hard as steel. It has 10,000-HP strength. However, it is too heavy.

flavor_text.blue: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
flavor_text.crystal: During the study of this POKéMON, it was discovered that its compo nents are not found in nature.
flavor_text.diamond: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
flavor_text.emerald: It bears an uncanny and unexplained resemblance to a POKé BALL. Because it explodes at the slightest shock, even veteran TRAINERS treat it with caution.
flavor_text.firered: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.
flavor_text.gold: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
flavor_text.heartgold: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, it has zapped many people.
flavor_text.pearl: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
flavor_text.platinum: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.
flavor_text.red: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.
flavor_text.ruby: VOLTORB was first sighted at a company that manufactures POKé BALLS. The link between that sighting and the fact that this POKéMON looks very similar to a POKé BALL remains a mystery.
flavor_text.sapphire: VOLTORB is extremely sensitive - it explodes at the slightest of shocks. It is rumored that it was first created when a POKé BALL was exposed to a powerful pulse of energy.
flavor_text.silver: It was discovered when POKé BALLS were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.
flavor_text.yellow: It is said to camouflage itself as a POKé BALL. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.

flavor_text.blue: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
flavor_text.crystal: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.
flavor_text.diamond: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavor_text.emerald: They appear in great numbers at electric power plants. Because they feed on electricity, they cause massive and chaotic blackouts in nearby cities.
flavor_text.firered: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
flavor_text.gold: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
flavor_text.pearl: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavor_text.platinum: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.
flavor_text.red: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.
flavor_text.ruby: ELECTRODE eats electricity in the atmosphere. On days when lightning strikes, you can see this POKéMON exploding all over the place from eating too much electricity.
flavor_text.sapphire: One of ELECTRODE’s characteristics is its attraction to electricity. It is a problematical POKéMON that congregates mostly at electrical power plants to feed on electricity that has just been generated.
flavor_text.silver: It stores an over flowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
flavor_text.yellow: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.

flavor_text.blue: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
flavor_text.crystal: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.
flavor_text.diamond: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavor_text.emerald: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.
flavor_text.firered: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.
flavor_text.gold: The shell is very durable. Even if it cracks, it can survive without spilling the contents.
flavor_text.heartgold: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
flavor_text.pearl: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavor_text.platinum: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.
flavor_text.red: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.
flavor_text.ruby: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.
flavor_text.silver: Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.yellow: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.

flavor_text.blue: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.crystal: Living in a good environment makes it grow lots of heads. A head that drops off becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.diamond: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.emerald: Originally from the tropics, EXEGGUTOR’s heads grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall, they group to form an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.firered: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.
flavor_text.gold: Its three heads think independent ly. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.pearl: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.platinum: It is called “The Walking Jungle.” If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.red: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.ruby: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.sapphire: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form EXEGGCUTE.
flavor_text.silver: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an EXEGGCUTE cluster.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an EXEGGCUTE cluster.
flavor_text.yellow: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the 3 heads thinks about whatever it likes.

flavor_text.blue: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
flavor_text.crystal: It lost its mother after its birth. It wears its mother's skull, never revealing its true face.
flavor_text.diamond: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavor_text.emerald: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.
flavor_text.firered: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
flavor_text.gold: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes, and emits a plain tive and mournful sound.
flavor_text.heartgold: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON’s real face.
flavor_text.pearl: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavor_text.platinum: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.
flavor_text.red: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.
flavor_text.ruby: CUBONE pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the POKéMON wears are made by the tears it sheds.
flavor_text.sapphire: CUBONE pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull the POKéMON wears are made by the tears it sheds.
flavor_text.silver: It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It always wears the skull of its dead mother, so no one has any idea what its hidden face looks like.
flavor_text.yellow: Wears the skull of its deceased mother. Its cries echo inside the skull and come out as a sad melody.

flavor_text.blue: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
flavor_text.crystal: Somewhere in the world is a ceme tery just for MAROWAK. It gets its bones from those graves.
flavor_text.diamond: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavor_text.emerald: A MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
flavor_text.firered: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
flavor_text.gold: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out mes sages to others.
flavor_text.heartgold: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
flavor_text.pearl: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavor_text.platinum: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
flavor_text.red: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.
flavor_text.ruby: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This POKéMON’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
flavor_text.sapphire: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This POKéMON’s tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
flavor_text.silver: It collects bones from an unknown place. A MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world, rumors say.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It collects bones from an unknown place. Some whisper that a MAROWAK graveyard exists somewhere in the world.
flavor_text.yellow: Small and weak, this POKéMON is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.

flavor_text.blue: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
flavor_text.crystal: It is also called the Kick Master. It uses its elastic legs to execute every known kick.
flavor_text.diamond: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavor_text.emerald: Its legs freely stretch and contract. Using these springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its tired legs.
flavor_text.firered: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
flavor_text.gold: This amazing POKé MON has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
flavor_text.heartgold: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long, loping strides.
flavor_text.pearl: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavor_text.platinum: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.
flavor_text.red: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
flavor_text.ruby: HITMONLEE’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
flavor_text.sapphire: HITMONLEE’s legs freely contract and stretch. Using these springlike legs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks. After battle, it rubs down its legs and loosens the muscles to overcome fatigue.
flavor_text.silver: If it starts kick ing repeatedly, both legs will stretch even long er to strike a fleeing foe.
flavor_text.soulsilver: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
flavor_text.yellow: When kicking, the sole of its foot turns as hard as a diamond on im pact and destroys its enemy.

flavor_text.blue: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
flavor_text.crystal: To increase the strength of all its punch moves, it spins its arms just before making contact.
flavor_text.diamond: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavor_text.emerald: A HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who aimed to become the world champion. Having an indomitable spirit means that it will never give up.
flavor_text.firered: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.
flavor_text.gold: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
flavor_text.leafgreen: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.
flavor_text.pearl: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavor_text.platinum: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.
flavor_text.red: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
flavor_text.ruby: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working towards a world championship. This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
flavor_text.sapphire: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the spirit of a boxer who had been working towards a world championship. This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit and will never give up in the face of adversity.
flavor_text.silver: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
flavor_text.yellow: Punches in cork screw fashion. It can punch its way through a concrete wall in the same way as a drill.

flavor_text.blue: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
flavor_text.crystal: It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.
flavor_text.diamond: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.
flavor_text.emerald: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
flavor_text.firered: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
flavor_text.gold: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deft ly manipulated.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon’s. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
flavor_text.pearl: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.
flavor_text.platinum: When it extends its over-six-foot- long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.
flavor_text.red: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.
flavor_text.ruby: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
flavor_text.sapphire: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.
flavor_text.silver: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to any thing, so it is very useful.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.
flavor_text.yellow: Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.

flavor_text.blue: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
flavor_text.crystal: If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.
flavor_text.diamond: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
flavor_text.emerald: Getting up close to a KOFFING will give you a chance to observe, through its thin skin, the toxic gases swirling inside. It blows up at the slightest stimulation.
flavor_text.firered: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
flavor_text.gold: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
flavor_text.pearl: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
flavor_text.platinum: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.
flavor_text.red: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
flavor_text.ruby: If KOFFING becomes agitated, it raises the toxicity of its internal gases and jets them out from all over its body. This POKéMON may also overinflate its round body, then explode.
flavor_text.sapphire: KOFFING embodies toxic substances. It mixes the toxins with raw garbage to set off a chemical reaction that results in a terribly powerful poison gas. The higher the temperature, the more gas is concocted by this POKéMON.
flavor_text.silver: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slight ly airborne.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slightly airborne.
flavor_text.yellow: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!

flavor_text.blue: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
flavor_text.crystal: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.
flavor_text.diamond: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
flavor_text.emerald: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To WEEZING, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
flavor_text.firered: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.
flavor_text.gold: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It con stantly mixes its poisonous gases.
flavor_text.heartgold: If one of the twin KOFFING inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two KOFFING can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
flavor_text.pearl: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
flavor_text.platinum: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.
flavor_text.red: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
flavor_text.ruby: WEEZING loves the gases given off by rotted kitchen garbage. This POKéMON will find a dirty, unkempt house and make it its home. At night, when the people in the house are asleep, it will go through the trash.
flavor_text.sapphire: WEEZING alternately shrinks and inflates its twin bodies to mix together toxic gases inside. The more the gases are mixed, the more powerful the toxins become. The POKéMON also becomes more putrid.
flavor_text.silver: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the high est level.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Top-grade perfume is made using its internal poison gases by diluting them to the highest level.
flavor_text.yellow: It lives and grows by absorbing dust, germs and poison gases that are contained in toxic waste and garbage.

flavor_text.blue: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
flavor_text.crystal: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
flavor_text.diamond: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
flavor_text.emerald: Once it starts running, it doesn’t stop. Its tiny brain makes it so stupid that it can’t remember why it started running in the first place.
flavor_text.firered: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.
flavor_text.gold: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is inept at turning because of its four short legs. It can only charge and run in one direction.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. Its TACKLE can knock a semitrailer flying.
flavor_text.pearl: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.
flavor_text.platinum: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.
flavor_text.red: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
flavor_text.ruby: RHYHORN runs in a straight line, smashing everything in its path. It is not bothered even if it rushes headlong into a block of steel. This POKéMON may feel some pain from the collision the next day, however.
flavor_text.sapphire: RHYHORN’s brain is very small. It is so dense, while on a run it forgets why it started running in the first place. It apparently remembers sometimes if it demolishes something.
flavor_text.silver: It doesn't care if there is anything in its way. It just charges and destroys all ob stacles.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It doesn’t care if there is anything in its way. It just charges and destroys all obstacles.
flavor_text.yellow: A POKéMON with a one-track mind. Once it charges, it won't stop running until it falls asleep.

flavor_text.blue: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
flavor_text.crystal: By lightly spin ning its drill- like horn, it can easily shatter even a diamond in the rough.
flavor_text.diamond: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
flavor_text.emerald: Its horn, which rotates like a drill, destroys tall buildings with one strike. It stands on its hind legs, and its brain is well developed.
flavor_text.firered: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
flavor_text.gold: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its rugged hide protects it from even the heat of lava. However, the hide also makes it insensitive.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor_text.pearl: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
flavor_text.platinum: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.
flavor_text.red: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
flavor_text.ruby: RHYDON’s horn can crush even uncut diamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail can topple a building. This POKéMON’s hide is extremely tough. Even direct cannon hits don’t leave a scratch.
flavor_text.sapphire: RHYDON has a horn that serves as a drill. It is used for destroying rocks and boulders. This POKéMON occasionally rams into streams of magma, but the armor-like hide prevents it from feeling the heat.
flavor_text.silver: Its brain devel oped when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its brain developed when it began walking on hind legs. Its thick hide protects it even in magma.
flavor_text.yellow: Walks on its hind legs. Shows signs of intelligence. Its armor-like hide even repels molten lava.

flavor_text.blue: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
flavor_text.crystal: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.
flavor_text.diamond: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
flavor_text.emerald: CHANSEY lay nutritionally excellent eggs every day. The eggs are so delicious, they are eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
flavor_text.firered: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.
flavor_text.gold: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
flavor_text.heartgold: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.
flavor_text.pearl: It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them with those who have evil in their hearts.
flavor_text.platinum: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.
flavor_text.red: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.
flavor_text.ruby: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
flavor_text.sapphire: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent eggs on an everyday basis. The eggs are so delicious, they are easily and eagerly devoured by even those people who have lost their appetite.
flavor_text.silver: Few in number and difficult to cap ture, it is said to bring happiness to the trainer who catches it.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Being few in number and difficult to capture, it is said to bring happiness to the Trainer who catches it.
flavor_text.yellow: A gentle and kind hearted POKéMON that shares its nutritious eggs if it sees an injured POKéMON.

flavor_text.blue: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
flavor_text.crystal: During battle, it constantly moves the vines that cover its body in order to annoy its opponent.
flavor_text.diamond: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
flavor_text.emerald: Its vines snap off easily and painlessly if they are grabbed, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by new growth the very next day.
flavor_text.firered: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.
flavor_text.gold: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively un nerve its foes.
flavor_text.heartgold: The vines that cloak its entire body are always jiggling. They effectively unnerve its foes.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.
flavor_text.pearl: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.
flavor_text.platinum: The blue vines shrouding its body are covered in a growth of fine hair. It is known to be ticklish.
flavor_text.red: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to sea weed. Its vines shake as it walks.
flavor_text.ruby: TANGELA’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
flavor_text.sapphire: TANGELA’s vines snap off easily if they are grabbed. This happens without pain, allowing it to make a quick getaway. The lost vines are replaced by newly grown vines the very next day.
flavor_text.silver: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.
flavor_text.yellow: Its identity is obscured by masses of thick, blue vines. The vines are said to never stop growing.

flavor_text.blue: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
flavor_text.crystal: To avoid crushing the baby it carries in its pouch, it always sleeps standing up.
flavor_text.diamond: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavor_text.emerald: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, never try to catch it. The baby’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged.
flavor_text.firered: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.
flavor_text.gold: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
flavor_text.heartgold: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother’s protective pouch until it is three years old.
flavor_text.pearl: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavor_text.platinum: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
flavor_text.red: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
flavor_text.ruby: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby POKéMON’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
flavor_text.sapphire: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby POKéMON’s parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
flavor_text.silver: To protect its young, it will never give up during battle, no matter how badly wounded it is.
flavor_text.soulsilver: To protect its young, it will never give up during battle, no matter how badly wounded it is.
flavor_text.yellow: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.

flavor_text.blue: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
flavor_text.crystal: When they're in a safe location, they can be seen playfully tangling their tails together.
flavor_text.diamond: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavor_text.emerald: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.
flavor_text.firered: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
flavor_text.gold: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.
flavor_text.heartgold: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its well-developed dorsal fin.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
flavor_text.pearl: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavor_text.platinum: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
flavor_text.red: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
flavor_text.ruby: HORSEA eats small insects and moss off of rocks. If the ocean current turns fast, this POKéMON anchors itself by wrapping its tail around rocks or coral to prevent being washed away.
flavor_text.sapphire: If HORSEA senses danger, it will reflexively spray a dense black ink from its mouth and try to escape. This POKéMON swims by cleverly flapping the fins on its back.
flavor_text.silver: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.
flavor_text.yellow: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

flavor_text.blue: Capable of swim ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
flavor_text.crystal: The male raises the young. If it is approached, it uses its toxic spikes to fend off the intruder.
flavor_text.diamond: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
flavor_text.emerald: The poisonous barbs all over its body are highly valued as ingredients for making traditional herbal medicine. It shows no mercy to anything approaching its nest.
flavor_text.firered: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
flavor_text.gold: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
flavor_text.heartgold: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in HORSEA. It became a hot topic.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.
flavor_text.pearl: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
flavor_text.platinum: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.
flavor_text.red: Capable of swim ming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
flavor_text.ruby: SEADRA sleeps after wriggling itself between the branches of coral. Those trying to harvest coral are occasionally stung by this POKéMON’s poison barbs if they fail to notice it.
flavor_text.sapphire: SEADRA generates whirlpools by spinning its body. The whirlpools are strong enough to swallow even fishing boats. This POKéMON weakens prey with these currents, then swallows it whole.
flavor_text.silver: Its fin-tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its fin-tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.
flavor_text.yellow: Touching the back fin causes numb ness. It hooks its tail to coral to stay in place while sleeping.

flavor_text.blue: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
flavor_text.crystal: During spawning season, they swim gracefully in the water, searching for their perfect mate.
flavor_text.diamond: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.
flavor_text.emerald: In the springtime, schools of GOLDEEN can be seen swimming up falls and rivers. It metes out staggering damage with its single horn.
flavor_text.firered: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
flavor_text.gold: Its dorsal, pecto ral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its dorsal, pectoral and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the water dancer.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of “The Water Queen.”
flavor_text.pearl: It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.
flavor_text.platinum: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.
flavor_text.red: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.
flavor_text.ruby: GOLDEEN is a very beautiful POKéMON with fins that billow elegantly in water. However, don’t let your guard down around this POKéMON - it could ram you powerfully with its horn.
flavor_text.sapphire: GOLDEEN loves swimming wild and free in rivers and ponds. If one of these POKéMON is placed in an aquarium, it will shatter even the thickest glass with one ram of its horn and make its escape.
flavor_text.silver: A strong swimmer, it is capable of swimming nonstop up fast streams at a steady speed of five knots.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A strong swimmer, it is capable of swimming nonstop up fast streams at a steady speed of five knots per hour.
flavor_text.yellow: When it is time for them to lay eggs, they can be seen swimming up rivers and falls in large groups.

flavor_text.blue: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power fully up rivers and creeks.
flavor_text.crystal: When autumn comes, the males patrol the area around their nests in order to protect their offspring.
flavor_text.diamond: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.
flavor_text.emerald: It punches holes in boulders on stream beds. This is a clever innovation that prevents its eggs from being attacked or washed away by the current.
flavor_text.firered: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.
flavor_text.gold: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, coloring the rivers a brilliant red.
flavor_text.heartgold: During spawning season, SEAKING gather from all over, causing rivers to appear a brilliant red.
flavor_text.leafgreen: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.
flavor_text.pearl: To protect its family, it will fight with its drill-sharp horn. It lives in hollowed rocks in streams.
flavor_text.platinum: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
flavor_text.red: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming power fully up rivers and creeks.
flavor_text.ruby: In the autumn, SEAKING males can be seen performing courtship dances in riverbeds to woo females. During this season, this POKéMON’s body coloration is at its most beautiful.
flavor_text.sapphire: SEAKING is very protective of its eggs. The male and female will take turns patrolling around their nest and eggs. The guarding of eggs by these POKéMON goes on for over a month.
flavor_text.silver: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
flavor_text.yellow: It is the male's job to make a nest by carving out boulders in a stream using the horn on its head.

flavor_text.blue: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
flavor_text.crystal: When the stars twinkle at night, it floats up from the sea floor, and its body's center core flickers.
flavor_text.diamond: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
flavor_text.emerald: It gathers with others in the night and makes its red core glow on and off with the twinkling stars. It can regenerate limbs if they are severed from its body.
flavor_text.firered: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.
flavor_text.gold: At night, the cen ter of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
flavor_text.heartgold: At night, the middle of its body slowly flickers with the same rhythm as a human heartbeat.
flavor_text.leafgreen: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
flavor_text.pearl: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
flavor_text.platinum: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.
flavor_text.red: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.
flavor_text.ruby: STARYU’s center section has an organ called the core that shines bright red. If you go to a beach toward the end of summer, the glowing cores of these POKéMON look like the stars in the sky.
flavor_text.sapphire: STARYU apparently communicates with the stars in the night sky by flashing the red core at the center of its body. If parts of its body are torn, this POKéMON simply regenerates the missing pieces and limbs.
flavor_text.silver: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core re mains intact.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long as the glowing central core remains intact.
flavor_text.yellow: As long as the center section is unharmed, it can grow back fully even if it is chopped to bits.

flavor_text.blue: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
flavor_text.crystal: It is said that it uses the seven- colored core of its body to send electric waves into outer space.
flavor_text.diamond: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
flavor_text.emerald: People in ancient times imagined that STARMIE were transformed from the reflections of stars that twinkled on gentle waves at night.
flavor_text.firered: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
flavor_text.gold: The center section of its body is called the core. It glows in a dif ferent color each time it is seen.
flavor_text.heartgold: The middle section of its body is called the core. It glows in a different color each time it is seen.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
flavor_text.pearl: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
flavor_text.platinum: At the center of its body is a red core, which sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.
flavor_text.red: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.
flavor_text.ruby: STARMIE’s center section - the core - glows brightly in seven colors. Because of its luminous nature, this POKéMON has been given the nickname “the gem of the sea.”
flavor_text.sapphire: STARMIE swims through water by spinning its star-shaped body as if it were a propeller on a ship. The core at the center of this POKéMON’s body glows in seven colors.
flavor_text.silver: Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geo metric shape.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Regardless of the environment it lives in, its body grows to form a symmetrical geometric shape.
flavor_text.yellow: The center section is named the core. People think it is communicating when it glows in 7 colors.

flavor_text.blue: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
flavor_text.crystal: It uses the mysterious power it has in its fingers to solidify air into an invisible wall.
flavor_text.diamond: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
flavor_text.emerald: A MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. It can convince others that something unseeable actually exists. Once believed, the imaginary object does become real.
flavor_text.firered: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.
flavor_text.gold: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisi ble objects as it matures.
flavor_text.heartgold: A skilled mime from birth, it gains the ability to create invisible objects as it matures.
flavor_text.leafgreen: If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its broad hands.
flavor_text.pearl: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.
flavor_text.platinum: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.
flavor_text.red: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.
flavor_text.ruby: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once it is believed, it will exist as if it were a real thing.
flavor_text.sapphire: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime. Its gestures and motions convince watchers that something unseeable actually exists. Once it is believed, it will exist as if it were a real thing.
flavor_text.silver: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.
flavor_text.yellow: Always practices its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.

flavor_text.blue: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
flavor_text.crystal: It's very proud of its speed. It moves so fast that its opponent does not even know what knocked it down.
flavor_text.diamond: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
flavor_text.emerald: Its blindingly fast speed adds to the sharpness of its twin forearm scythes. The scythes can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
flavor_text.firered: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
flavor_text.gold: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
flavor_text.heartgold: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.
flavor_text.leafgreen: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of itself.
flavor_text.pearl: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.
flavor_text.platinum: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
flavor_text.red: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.
flavor_text.ruby: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This POKéMON’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
flavor_text.sapphire: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing speed enhances the effectiveness of the twin scythes on its forearms. This POKéMON’s scythes are so effective, they can slice through thick logs in one wicked stroke.
flavor_text.silver: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its pro tective colors make it invisible.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective coloration makes it invisible.
flavor_text.yellow: Leaps out of tall grass and slices prey with its scythes. The move ment looks like that of a ninja.

flavor_text.blue: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
flavor_text.crystal: It has several different cry pat terns, each of which seems to have its own meaning.
flavor_text.diamond: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavor_text.emerald: A JYNX sashays rhythmically as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without noticing.
flavor_text.firered: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.
flavor_text.gold: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depend ing on how it is feeling.
flavor_text.heartgold: It rocks its body rhythmically. It appears to alter the rhythm depending on how it is feeling.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
flavor_text.pearl: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavor_text.platinum: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.
flavor_text.red: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
flavor_text.ruby: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
flavor_text.sapphire: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and shaking its hips as if it were dancing. Its motions are so bouncingly alluring, people seeing it are compelled to shake their hips without giving any thought to what they are doing.
flavor_text.silver: It speaks a lan guage similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It speaks a language similar to that of humans. However, it seems to use dancing to communicate.
flavor_text.yellow: Appears to move to a rhythm of its own, as if it were dancing. It wiggles its hips as it walks.

flavor_text.blue: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
flavor_text.crystal: When two ELECTABUZZ touch, they control the electric currents to communicate their feelings.
flavor_text.diamond: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
flavor_text.emerald: When a storm approaches, it competes with others to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
flavor_text.firered: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
flavor_text.gold: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its en tire body glows a whitish-blue.
flavor_text.heartgold: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
flavor_text.pearl: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
flavor_text.platinum: It windmills its arms to slightly boost its punches. Foes have been known to escape in the meantime.
flavor_text.red: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.
flavor_text.ruby: When a storm arrives, gangs of this POKéMON compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
flavor_text.sapphire: When a storm arrives, gangs of this POKéMON compete with each other to scale heights that are likely to be stricken by lightning bolts. Some towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of lightning rods.
flavor_text.silver: Its body constant ly discharges electricity. Get ting close to it will make your hair stand on end.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.
flavor_text.yellow: If a major power outage occurs, it is certain that this POKéMON has eaten electricity at a power plant.

flavor_text.blue: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
flavor_text.crystal: It moves more frequently in hot areas. It can heal itself by dipping its wound into lava.
flavor_text.diamond: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.
flavor_text.emerald: In battle, it blows out intense flames from all over its body to intimidate its foe. These fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in the area.
flavor_text.firered: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor_text.gold: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suit able for itself.
flavor_text.heartgold: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly amidst flames.
flavor_text.pearl: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.
flavor_text.platinum: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.
flavor_text.red: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.
flavor_text.ruby: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This POKéMON’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
flavor_text.sapphire: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely hot flames from all over its body to intimidate its opponent. This POKéMON’s fiery bursts create heat waves that ignite grass and trees in its surroundings.
flavor_text.silver: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.
flavor_text.yellow: Born in an active volcano. Its body is always cloaked in flames, so it looks like a big ball of fire.

flavor_text.blue: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
flavor_text.crystal: When the tempera ture drops at night, it sleeps on treetops or among roots where it is well hidden.
flavor_text.diamond: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavor_text.emerald: Their pincers are strong enough to shatter thick logs. Because they dislike cold, PINSIR burrow and sleep under the ground on chilly nights.
flavor_text.firered: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.
flavor_text.gold: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
flavor_text.heartgold: With its pincer horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.
flavor_text.leafgreen: If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.
flavor_text.pearl: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavor_text.platinum: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can’t tear, it tosses far.
flavor_text.red: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.
flavor_text.ruby: PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This POKéMON’s movements turn sluggish in cold places.
flavor_text.sapphire: PINSIR has a pair of massive horns Protruding from the surface of these horns are thorns. These thorns are driven deeply into the foe’s body when the pincer closes, making it tough for the foe to escape.
flavor_text.silver: Swings its long antlers wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
flavor_text.yellow: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold, so it lives in warm places.

flavor_text.blue: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
