flavor_text.crystal: These violent POKéMON fight with other mem bers of their herd in order to prove their strength.
flavor_text.diamond: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavor_text.emerald: It is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
flavor_text.firered: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.
flavor_text.gold: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its bat tle-scarred horns.
flavor_text.heartgold: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
flavor_text.pearl: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavor_text.platinum: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.
flavor_text.red: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.
flavor_text.ruby: This POKéMON is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON is not satisfied unless it is rampaging at all times. If there is no opponent for TAUROS to battle, it will charge at thick trees and knock them down to calm itself.
flavor_text.silver: After heightening its will to fight by whipping itself with its three tails, it charges at full speed.

flavor_text.heartgold: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions, but usually not more than seven feet.
flavor_text.leafgreen: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
flavor_text.pearl: It is unable to swim against even slow-moving currents. It always splashes about for some reason.

flavor_text.red: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.
flavor_text.ruby: MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a POKéMON that is only capable of flopping and splashing. This behavior prompted scientists to undertake research into it.

flavor_text.ruby: Despite the smallness of its body, TOTODILE’s jaws are very powerful. While the POKéMON may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
flavor_text.sapphire: Despite the smallness of its body, TOTODILE’s jaws are very powerful. While the POKéMON may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
flavor_text.silver: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

flavor_text.crystal: The tips of its fangs are slanted backward. Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has no hope of escape.
flavor_text.diamond: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
flavor_text.emerald: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.
flavor_text.firered: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.
flavor_text.gold: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
flavor_text.heartgold: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
flavor_text.leafgreen: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
flavor_text.pearl: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
flavor_text.platinum: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
flavor_text.ruby: Once CROCONAW has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
flavor_text.sapphire: Once CROCONAW has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
flavor_text.silver: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

flavor_text.crystal: Although it has a massive body, its powerful hind legs enable it to move quickly, even on the ground.
flavor_text.diamond: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
flavor_text.emerald: It opens its huge mouth to intimidate enemies. In battle, it runs using its thick and powerful hind legs to charge the foe with incredible speed.
flavor_text.firered: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.
flavor_text.gold: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears up its victim.
flavor_text.pearl: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
flavor_text.platinum: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
flavor_text.ruby: FERALIGATR intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
flavor_text.sapphire: FERALIGATR intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
flavor_text.silver: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is hard for it to support its weight out of water, so it sometimes gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

flavor_text.crystal: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
flavor_text.diamond: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
flavor_text.emerald: They take turns standing guard when it is time to sleep. The sentry awakens the others if it senses danger. If one becomes separated, it turns sleepless with fear.
flavor_text.firered: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
flavor_text.gold: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
flavor_text.heartgold: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
flavor_text.leafgreen: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
flavor_text.pearl: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
flavor_text.platinum: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
flavor_text.ruby: When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this POKéMON becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
flavor_text.sapphire: When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this POKéMON becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
flavor_text.silver: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

flavor_text.crystal: It lives in narrow burrows that fit its slim body. The deeper the nests go, the more maze like they become.
flavor_text.diamond: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
flavor_text.emerald: A FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, it is very nimble and fleet.
flavor_text.firered: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.
flavor_text.gold: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
flavor_text.heartgold: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
flavor_text.pearl: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
flavor_text.platinum: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
flavor_text.ruby: FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this POKéMON is very nimble and fleet.
flavor_text.sapphire: FURRET has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this POKéMON is very nimble and fleet.
flavor_text.silver: There is no tell ing where the tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunt ing RATTATA.
flavor_text.soulsilver: There is no telling where the tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick and likes to chase RATTATA.

flavor_text.crystal: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.
flavor_text.diamond: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.
flavor_text.emerald: It has an internal organ that senses the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, a HOOTHOOT begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
flavor_text.firered: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.
flavor_text.gold: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
flavor_text.heartgold: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
flavor_text.pearl: It switches its standing foot so quickly, it can’t be seen. It cries at the same time every day.
flavor_text.platinum: It marks time precisely. Some countries consider it to be a wise friend, versed in the world’s ways.
flavor_text.ruby: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this POKéMON begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
flavor_text.sapphire: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this POKéMON begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
flavor_text.silver: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

flavor_text.crystal: Its extremely soft feathers make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.
flavor_text.diamond: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.
flavor_text.emerald: It unfailingly catches prey in darkness. NOCTOWL owe their success to superior vision that allows them to see in minimal light, and to their supple and silent wings.
flavor_text.firered: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
flavor_text.gold: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.
flavor_text.pearl: If it flips its head upside down, it’s a sign that it is engaged in very complex thinking.
flavor_text.platinum: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
flavor_text.ruby: NOCTOWL never fails at catching prey in darkness. This POKéMON owes its success to its superior vision that allows it to see in minimal light, and to its soft, supple wings that make no sound in flight.
flavor_text.sapphire: NOCTOWL never fails at catching prey in darkness. This POKéMON owes its success to its superior vision that allows it to see in minimal light, and to its soft, supple wings that make no sound in flight.
flavor_text.silver: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 de grees to sharpen its intellectual power.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

flavor_text.crystal: It is timid and clusters together with others. The fluid secreted by its feet indicates its location.
flavor_text.diamond: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavor_text.emerald: LEDYBA communicate using a fluid that they secrete from where the legs join the body. They are said to convey feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
flavor_text.firered: When the weather turns cold, numerous LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
flavor_text.gold: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.
flavor_text.pearl: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavor_text.platinum: It is so timid, it can’t move if it isn’t with a swarm of others. It conveys its feelings with scent.
flavor_text.ruby: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This POKéMON conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
flavor_text.sapphire: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from where its legs join its body. This fluid is used for communicating with others. This POKéMON conveys its feelings to others by altering the fluid’s scent.
flavor_text.silver: When the weather turns cold, lots of LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When the weather turns cold, lots of LEDYBA gather from everywhere to cluster and keep each other warm.

flavor_text.crystal: In the daytime when it gets warm, it curls up inside a big leaf and drifts off into a deep slumber.
flavor_text.diamond: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavor_text.emerald: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live many LEDIAN. For good reason, they use the light of the stars as energy.
flavor_text.firered: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.
flavor_text.gold: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavor_text.heartgold: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.
flavor_text.pearl: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavor_text.platinum: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.
flavor_text.ruby: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live LEDIAN in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this - the POKéMON uses the light of the stars as its energy.
flavor_text.sapphire: It is said that in lands with clean air, where the stars fill the sky, there live LEDIAN in countless numbers. There is a good reason for this - the POKéMON uses the light of the stars as its energy.
flavor_text.silver: The star patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

flavor_text.crystal: If prey becomes ensnared in its nest of spun string, it waits motionlessly until it becomes dark.
flavor_text.diamond: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavor_text.emerald: The web it spins can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that a SPINARAK determines its prey by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web.
flavor_text.firered: It spins a web using fine--but durable-- thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.
flavor_text.gold: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
flavor_text.heartgold: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.
flavor_text.pearl: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavor_text.platinum: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.
flavor_text.ruby: The web spun by SPINARAK can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this POKéMON can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
flavor_text.sapphire: The web spun by SPINARAK can be considered its second nervous system. It is said that this POKéMON can determine what kind of prey is touching its web just by the tiny vibrations it feels through the web’s strands.
flavor_text.silver: It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits pa tiently for prey to be trapped.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It spins a web using fine--but durable--thread. It then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

flavor_text.crystal: Rather than mak ing a nest in one specific spot, it wanders in search of food after darkness falls.
flavor_text.diamond: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavor_text.emerald: Its feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. It constricts its foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
flavor_text.firered: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.
flavor_text.gold: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
flavor_text.heartgold: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It is hard to tell which end is which.
flavor_text.pearl: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavor_text.platinum: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.
flavor_text.ruby: ARIADOS’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This POKéMON constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
flavor_text.sapphire: ARIADOS’s feet are tipped with tiny hooked claws that enable it to scuttle on ceilings and vertical walls. This POKéMON constricts the foe with thin and strong silk webbing.
flavor_text.silver: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A single strand of a special string is endlessly spun out of its rear. The string leads back to its nest.

flavor_text.crystal: As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.
flavor_text.diamond: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
flavor_text.emerald: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.
flavor_text.firered: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.
flavor_text.gold: It flies so si lently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
flavor_text.heartgold: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon that gained vastly enhanced flying performance by having its legs turn into wings.
flavor_text.platinum: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.
flavor_text.ruby: If this POKéMON is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that CROBAT has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.
flavor_text.sapphire: CROBAT sneaks up on its intended prey using wings that barely make a sound. This POKéMON rests by hanging on a tree branch with its rear legs that serve as wings.
flavor_text.silver: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

flavor_text.crystal: Its antennae, whi ch evolved from a fin, have both po sitive and neg ative charges flo wing through them.
flavor_text.diamond: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavor_text.emerald: When it senses danger, it discharges positive and negative electricity from its two antennae. It lives in depths beyond sunlight’s reach.
flavor_text.firered: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
flavor_text.gold: It shoots positive and negative elec tricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
flavor_text.heartgold: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.
flavor_text.pearl: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavor_text.platinum: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.
flavor_text.ruby: CHINCHOU lets loose positive and negative electrical charges from its two antennas to make its prey faint. This POKéMON flashes its electric lights to exchange signals with others.
flavor_text.sapphire: CHINCHOU’s two antennas are filled with cells that generate strong electricity. This POKéMON’s cells create so much electrical power, it even makes itself tingle slightly.
flavor_text.silver: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communi cation is its constantly flash ing lights.
flavor_text.soulsilver: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

flavor_text.crystal: This POKéMON uses the bright part of its body, which changed from a dorsal fin, to lure prey.
flavor_text.diamond: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavor_text.emerald: The light-emitting orbs on its back are very bright. They are formed from a part of its dorsal fin. This POKéMON illuminates the inky darkness of deep seas.
flavor_text.firered: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
flavor_text.gold: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
flavor_text.heartgold: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.
flavor_text.pearl: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavor_text.platinum: LANTURN’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed “The Deep-Sea Star.”
flavor_text.ruby: LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea star” for its illuminated antenna. This POKéMON produces light by causing a chemical reaction between bacteria and its bodily fluids inside the antenna.
flavor_text.sapphire: LANTURN is known to emit light. If you peer down into the dark sea from a ship at night, you can sometimes see this POKéMON’s light rising from the depths where it swims. It gives the sea an appearance of a starlit night.
flavor_text.silver: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light, then swallows the immobilized prey in a single gulp.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It blinds prey with an intense burst of light. With the prey incapacitated, the Pokémon swallows it in a single gulp.

flavor_text.crystal: It is unskilled at storing electric power. Any kind of shock causes it to discharge energy spontaneously.
flavor_text.diamond: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
flavor_text.emerald: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
flavor_text.firered: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
flavor_text.gold: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.
flavor_text.pearl: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.
flavor_text.platinum: The electric sacs in its cheeks are small. If even a little electricity leaks, it becomes shocked.
flavor_text.ruby: PICHU charges itself with electricity more easily on days with thunderclouds or when the air is very dry. You can hear the crackling of static electricity coming off this POKéMON.
flavor_text.sapphire: When PICHU plays with others, it may short out electricity with another PICHU, creating a shower of sparks. In that event, this POKéMON will begin crying, startled by the flash of sparks.
flavor_text.silver: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

flavor_text.crystal: If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this POKéMON is certain to be within the immediate area.
flavor_text.diamond: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
flavor_text.emerald: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.
flavor_text.firered: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.
flavor_text.gold: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavor_text.heartgold: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.
flavor_text.pearl: Many appear when the night skies are filled with shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.
flavor_text.platinum: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.
flavor_text.ruby: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these POKéMON quench their thirst with the morning dew.
flavor_text.sapphire: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these POKéMON quench their thirst with the morning dew.
flavor_text.silver: When numerous me teors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

flavor_text.crystal: Instead of walking with its short legs, it moves around by bouncing on its soft, tender body.
flavor_text.diamond: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
flavor_text.emerald: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.
flavor_text.firered: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.
flavor_text.gold: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
flavor_text.heartgold: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.
flavor_text.pearl: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
flavor_text.platinum: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.
flavor_text.ruby: IGGLYBUFF’s vocal chords are not sufficiently developed. It would hurt its throat if it were to sing too much. This POKéMON gargles with freshwater from a clean stream.
flavor_text.sapphire: IGGLYBUFF has a soft and plushy body that feels very much like a marshmallow. From this body wafts a gently sweet fragrance that soothes and calms the emotions of its foes.
flavor_text.silver: Its extremely flexible and elas tic body makes it bounce continuous ly--anytime, any where.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its extremely flexible and elastic body makes it bounce continuously--anytime, anywhere.

flavor_text.crystal: It is considered to be a symbol of good luck. Its shell is said to be filled with happiness.
flavor_text.diamond: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.
flavor_text.emerald: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
flavor_text.firered: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.
flavor_text.gold: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavor_text.heartgold: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
flavor_text.pearl: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.
flavor_text.platinum: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.
flavor_text.ruby: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. This POKéMON stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
flavor_text.sapphire: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. This POKéMON stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.
flavor_text.silver: A proverb claims that happiness will come to any one who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping TOGEPI stand up.

flavor_text.crystal: Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.
flavor_text.diamond: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called “joy dust.”
flavor_text.emerald: It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.
flavor_text.firered: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
flavor_text.gold: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, car ing people and shower them with happiness.
flavor_text.heartgold: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
flavor_text.leafgreen: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
flavor_text.pearl: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called “joy dust.”
flavor_text.platinum: To share its happiness, it flies around the world seeking kind hearted people.
flavor_text.ruby: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When the POKéMON spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
flavor_text.sapphire: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When the POKéMON spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
flavor_text.silver: It grows dispirit ed if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

flavor_text.crystal: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
flavor_text.diamond: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavor_text.emerald: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU’s eyes look as if they are always observing something.
flavor_text.firered: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.
flavor_text.gold: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always star ing at something.
flavor_text.heartgold: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
flavor_text.pearl: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavor_text.platinum: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.
flavor_text.ruby: NATU cannot fly because its wings are not yet fully grown. If your eyes meet with this POKéMON’s eyes, it will stare back intently at you. But if you move even slightly, it will hop away to safety.
flavor_text.sapphire: NATU has a highly developed jumping ability. The POKéMON flaps and leaps onto tree branches that are taller than grown-up people to pick at the tree’s new shoots.
flavor_text.silver: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

flavor_text.crystal: Once it begins to meditate at sun rise, the entire day will pass before it will move again.
flavor_text.diamond: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavor_text.emerald: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.
flavor_text.firered: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.
flavor_text.gold: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
flavor_text.heartgold: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
flavor_text.leafgreen: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
flavor_text.pearl: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavor_text.platinum: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
flavor_text.ruby: XATU stands rooted and still in one spot all day long. People believe that this POKéMON does so out of fear of the terrible things it has foreseen in the future.
flavor_text.sapphire: XATU is known to stand motionless while staring at the sun all day long. Some people revere it as a mystical POKéMON out of their belief that XATU is in possession of the power to see into the future.
flavor_text.silver: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.
flavor_text.soulsilver: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

flavor_text.crystal: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.
flavor_text.diamond: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.
flavor_text.emerald: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
flavor_text.firered: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
flavor_text.gold: If static elec tricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
flavor_text.heartgold: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
flavor_text.leafgreen: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.
flavor_text.pearl: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

flavor_text.sapphire: MAREEP’s fluffy coat of wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more static electricity is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail grows.

flavor_text.soulsilver: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

flavor_text.crystal: Because of its rubbery, electric ity-resistant skin, it can store lots of electric ity in its fur.
flavor_text.diamond: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
flavor_text.emerald: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
flavor_text.firered: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
flavor_text.gold: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
flavor_text.heartgold: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.
flavor_text.leafgreen: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

flavor_text.platinum: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.
flavor_text.ruby: FLAAFFY’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
flavor_text.sapphire: FLAAFFY’s wool quality changes so that it can generate a high amount of static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare and slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
flavor_text.silver: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its fluffy fleece easily stores electricity. Its rubbery hide keeps it from being electrocuted.

flavor_text.crystal: When it gets dark, the light from its bright, shiny tail can be seen from far away on the ocean's surface.
flavor_text.diamond: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
flavor_text.emerald: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
flavor_text.firered: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.
flavor_text.gold: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
flavor_text.heartgold: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

flavor_text.platinum: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail’s light.
flavor_text.ruby: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this POKéMON to send signals back and forth with others far away.
flavor_text.sapphire: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used the light of this POKéMON to send signals back and forth with others far away.
flavor_text.silver: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The bright light on its tail can be seen far away. It has been treasured since ancient times as a beacon.

flavor_text.crystal: When these dance together, their petals rub against each other, making pretty, relaxing sounds.
flavor_text.diamond: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavor_text.emerald: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
flavor_text.firered: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
flavor_text.gold: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavor_text.heartgold: BELLOSSOM gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavor_text.leafgreen: BELLOSSOM gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
flavor_text.pearl: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavor_text.platinum: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.
flavor_text.ruby: When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty of sunlight, the leaves ringing its body begin to spin around. This POKéMON’s dancing is renowned in the southern lands.
flavor_text.sapphire: A BELLOSSOM grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly GLOOM - the stinkier the better. At night, this POKéMON closes its petals and goes to sleep.
flavor_text.silver: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

flavor_text.crystal: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
flavor_text.diamond: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.
flavor_text.emerald: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water’s resistance.
flavor_text.firered: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.
flavor_text.gold: The tip of its tail, which con tains oil that is lighter than wa ter, lets it swim without drowning.
flavor_text.heartgold: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.
flavor_text.pearl: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.
flavor_text.platinum: The oil-filled end of its tail floats on water. It keeps MARILL from drowning even in a strong current.
flavor_text.ruby: MARILL’s oil-filled tail acts much like a life preserver. If you see just its tail bobbing on the water’s surface, it’s a sure indication that this POKéMON is diving beneath the water to feed on aquatic plants.
flavor_text.sapphire: When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, MARILL wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This POKéMON’s tail is flexible and configured to stretch.
flavor_text.silver: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

flavor_text.crystal: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.
flavor_text.diamond: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
flavor_text.emerald: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.
flavor_text.firered: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.
flavor_text.gold: By keeping still and listening in tently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
flavor_text.heartgold: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.
flavor_text.leafgreen: By keeping still and listening intently, it can even tell what is in wild, fast-moving rivers.
flavor_text.pearl: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.
flavor_text.platinum: It can spend all day in water, since it can inhale and store a large volume of air.
flavor_text.ruby: AZUMARILL’s long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this POKéMON can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.
flavor_text.sapphire: AZUMARILL can make balloons out of air. It makes these air balloons if it spots a drowning POKéMON. The air balloons enable the POKéMON in trouble to breathe.
flavor_text.silver: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from get ting wet.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

flavor_text.crystal: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
flavor_text.diamond: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
flavor_text.emerald: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
flavor_text.firered: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.
flavor_text.gold: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composi tion appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
flavor_text.heartgold: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.
flavor_text.pearl: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.
flavor_text.platinum: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.
flavor_text.ruby: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because the forelegs remain green throughout the year, the POKéMON is easily identified as a fake during the winter.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

flavor_text.diamond: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
flavor_text.emerald: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
flavor_text.firered: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
flavor_text.gold: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gather ing from far and wide.
flavor_text.heartgold: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.
flavor_text.leafgreen: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

flavor_text.platinum: It gathers groups of others as their leader. Its cries make POLIWAG obey.
flavor_text.ruby: The curled hair on POLITOED’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this POKéMON earns from its peers.
flavor_text.sapphire: The curled hair on POLITOED’s head is proof of its status as a king. It is said that the longer and more curled the hair, the more respect this POKéMON earns from its peers.
flavor_text.silver: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

flavor_text.crystal: It can be carried away on even the gentlest breeze. It may even float all the way to the next town.
flavor_text.diamond: It drifts on winds. It is said that when HOPPIP gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
flavor_text.emerald: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.
flavor_text.firered: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
flavor_text.gold: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
flavor_text.heartgold: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

flavor_text.soulsilver: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.

flavor_text.crystal: As soon as it rains, it closes its flower and hides in the shade of a tree to avoid getting wet.
flavor_text.diamond: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
flavor_text.emerald: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower’s blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
flavor_text.firered: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.
flavor_text.gold: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluc tuates up and down.
flavor_text.heartgold: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

flavor_text.crystal: Even in the fierc est wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
flavor_text.diamond: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavor_text.emerald: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This POKéMON lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
flavor_text.firered: It drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
flavor_text.gold: Once it catches the wind, it deft ly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.
flavor_text.heartgold: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores-- it can even float around the world.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

flavor_text.platinum: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
flavor_text.ruby: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The POKéMON descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
flavor_text.sapphire: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The POKéMON descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
flavor_text.silver: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.

flavor_text.crystal: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.
flavor_text.diamond: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
flavor_text.emerald: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM’s real hands have become rather clumsy.
flavor_text.firered: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.
flavor_text.gold: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won’t fall off while asleep.
flavor_text.platinum: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.
flavor_text.ruby: AIPOM’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the POKéMON uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.
flavor_text.sapphire: AIPOM’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the POKéMON uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

flavor_text.crystal: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.
flavor_text.diamond: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
flavor_text.emerald: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
flavor_text.firered: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
flavor_text.gold: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavor_text.heartgold: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
flavor_text.pearl: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
flavor_text.platinum: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
flavor_text.ruby: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
flavor_text.sapphire: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

flavor_text.soulsilver: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

flavor_text.crystal: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this POKéMON's face become more vivid and lively.
flavor_text.diamond: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
flavor_text.emerald: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.
flavor_text.firered: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.

flavor_text.soulsilver: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

flavor_text.diamond: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
flavor_text.emerald: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.
flavor_text.firered: A POKéMON that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
flavor_text.gold: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Un able to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.

flavor_text.diamond: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
flavor_text.emerald: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.
flavor_text.firered: This POKéMON races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

flavor_text.crystal: Born deep under ground, this POKéMON becomes a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a mountain.
flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
flavor_text.emerald: A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents’ faces.
flavor_text.firered: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.
flavor_text.gold: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
flavor_text.heartgold: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.

flavor_text.ruby: LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. To come up to the surface, this POKéMON must eat its way through the soil above. Until it does so, LARVITAR cannot see its parent’s face.

flavor_text.crystal: It will not stay still, even while it's a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
flavor_text.diamond: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
flavor_text.emerald: A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.
flavor_text.firered: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
flavor_text.gold: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its THRASHING can topple a mountain.

flavor_text.platinum: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
flavor_text.ruby: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable - it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.
flavor_text.sapphire: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable - it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.

flavor_text.crystal: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and moun tains crumble.
flavor_text.diamond: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
flavor_text.emerald: A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
flavor_text.firered: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
flavor_text.gold: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

flavor_text.crystal: It has an incred ible ability to calm raging sto rms. It is said that LUGIA appears when storms start.
flavor_text.diamond: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
flavor_text.emerald: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
flavor_text.firered: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
flavor_text.gold: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

flavor_text.crystal: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted trainer by shining its bright rain bow-colored wings.
flavor_text.diamond: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
flavor_text.emerald: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
flavor_text.firered: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
flavor_text.gold: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies con tinuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.

flavor_text.crystal: Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI appears wherever beautiful forests exist.
flavor_text.diamond: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
flavor_text.emerald: This POKéMON came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
flavor_text.firered: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.
flavor_text.gold: This POKéMON wan ders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
flavor_text.heartgold: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
flavor_text.leafgreen: This POKéMON wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

flavor_text.diamond: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavor_text.emerald: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest’s trees.
flavor_text.firered: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
flavor_text.heartgold: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
flavor_text.pearl: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavor_text.platinum: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
flavor_text.ruby: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
flavor_text.sapphire: TREECKO is cool, calm, and collected - it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this POKéMON, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavor_text.emerald: Leaves grow out of this POKéMON’s body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.
flavor_text.firered: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
flavor_text.heartgold: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavor_text.platinum: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
flavor_text.ruby: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
flavor_text.sapphire: This POKéMON adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no POKéMON can ever hope to catch a fleeing GROVYLE however fast they may be.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.

flavor_text.diamond: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavor_text.emerald: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This POKéMON carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.
flavor_text.firered: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.
flavor_text.heartgold: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.
flavor_text.leafgreen: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.
flavor_text.pearl: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavor_text.platinum: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
flavor_text.ruby: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
flavor_text.sapphire: SCEPTILE has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This POKéMON raises the trees in a forest with loving care.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.

flavor_text.diamond: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavor_text.emerald: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can’t see its surroundings.
flavor_text.firered: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
flavor_text.heartgold: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
flavor_text.pearl: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavor_text.platinum: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
flavor_text.ruby: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
flavor_text.sapphire: TORCHIC has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug - it will be glowing with warmth. This POKéMON is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Inside its body is a place where it keeps a small flame. Hug it! It will be as warm as a hot-water bottle.

flavor_text.diamond: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavor_text.emerald: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.
flavor_text.firered: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
flavor_text.heartgold: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
flavor_text.pearl: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavor_text.platinum: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
flavor_text.ruby: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
flavor_text.sapphire: COMBUSKEN battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This POKéMON’s cry is very loud and distracting.
flavor_text.soulsilver: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

flavor_text.diamond: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavor_text.emerald: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.
flavor_text.firered: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
flavor_text.heartgold: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
flavor_text.pearl: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavor_text.platinum: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
flavor_text.ruby: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
flavor_text.sapphire: BLAZIKEN has incredibly strong legs - it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This POKéMON’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

flavor_text.diamond: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavor_text.emerald: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water’s edge.
flavor_text.firered: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
flavor_text.pearl: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavor_text.platinum: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
flavor_text.ruby: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
flavor_text.sapphire: In water, MUDKIP breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this POKéMON will unleash its amazing power - it can crush rocks bigger than itself.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.

flavor_text.diamond: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavor_text.emerald: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.
flavor_text.firered: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
flavor_text.heartgold: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
flavor_text.pearl: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavor_text.platinum: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
flavor_text.ruby: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
flavor_text.sapphire: MARSHTOMP is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This POKéMON’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.

flavor_text.diamond: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavor_text.emerald: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.
flavor_text.firered: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
flavor_text.pearl: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavor_text.platinum: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
flavor_text.ruby: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
flavor_text.sapphire: SWAMPERT predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavor_text.emerald: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.
flavor_text.firered: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
flavor_text.heartgold: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavor_text.platinum: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
flavor_text.ruby: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
flavor_text.sapphire: POOCHYENA is an omnivore - it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This POKéMON tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.

flavor_text.diamond: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
flavor_text.emerald: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader’s orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
flavor_text.firered: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
flavor_text.heartgold: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It will always obey the commands of a skilled TRAINER. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
flavor_text.pearl: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
flavor_text.platinum: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
