flavor_text.platinum: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
flavor_text.ruby: METAGROSS has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This POKéMON can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.
flavor_text.sapphire: METAGROSS is the result of two METANG achieving fusion. When hunting, this POKéMON pins the prey to the ground under its massive body. It then eats the helpless victim using the large mouth on its stomach.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

flavor_text.diamond: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavor_text.emerald: A POKéMON that is made entirely of rocks and boulders. If parts of its body chip off in battle, REGIROCK repairs itself by adding new rocks.
flavor_text.firered: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
flavor_text.heartgold: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is entirely composed of rocks with no sign of a brain or heart. It is a mystery even to modern scientists.
flavor_text.pearl: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavor_text.platinum: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
flavor_text.ruby: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
flavor_text.sapphire: REGIROCK’s body is composed entirely of rocks. Recently, a study made the startling discovery that the rocks were all unearthed from different locations.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

flavor_text.diamond: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor_text.emerald: Its entire body is made of Antarctic ice. After extensive studies, researchers believe the ice was formed during an ice age.
flavor_text.firered: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.
flavor_text.leafgreen: Research revealed that its body is made of the same kind of ice that is found at the South Pole.
flavor_text.pearl: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor_text.platinum: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavor_text.ruby: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
flavor_text.sapphire: REGICE cloaks itself with frigid air of negative 328 degrees F. Things will freeze solid just by going near this POKéMON. Its icy body is so cold, it will not melt even if it is immersed in magma.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can’t be melted, even by magma.

flavor_text.diamond: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavor_text.emerald: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.
flavor_text.firered: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is sturdier than any kind of metal. It hardened due to pressure underground over tens of thousands of years.
flavor_text.pearl: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavor_text.platinum: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
flavor_text.ruby: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
flavor_text.sapphire: REGISTEEL was imprisoned by people in ancient times. The metal composing its body is thought to be a curious substance that is not of this earth.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its body is said to be harder than any kind of metal. A study has revealed that its body is hollow.

flavor_text.diamond: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavor_text.emerald: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other POKéMON. They disappear if they sense enemies.
flavor_text.firered: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
flavor_text.heartgold: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
flavor_text.pearl: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavor_text.platinum: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
flavor_text.ruby: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
flavor_text.sapphire: LATIAS is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The POKéMON enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

flavor_text.diamond: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavor_text.emerald: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.
flavor_text.firered: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
flavor_text.heartgold: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
flavor_text.pearl: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavor_text.platinum: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
flavor_text.ruby: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
flavor_text.sapphire: LATIOS will only open its heart to a TRAINER with a compassionate spirit. This POKéMON can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

flavor_text.diamond: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavor_text.emerald: KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.
flavor_text.firered: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.
flavor_text.heartgold: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.
flavor_text.leafgreen: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.
flavor_text.pearl: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
flavor_text.ruby: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
flavor_text.sapphire: KYOGRE is named in mythology as the POKéMON that expanded the sea by covering the land with torrential rains and towering tidal waves. It took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with GROUDON.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.

flavor_text.diamond: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
flavor_text.emerald: GROUDON has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.
flavor_text.firered: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.
flavor_text.heartgold: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with KYOGRE.
flavor_text.leafgreen: This legendary POKéMON is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling KYOGRE.
flavor_text.pearl: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
flavor_text.platinum: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
flavor_text.ruby: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
flavor_text.sapphire: GROUDON has the power to scatter rain clouds and make water evaporate with light and heat. It came as a savior to people who had been suffering from terrible floods.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with KYOGRE.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavor_text.emerald: A POKéMON that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if KYOGRE and GROUDON were to fight.
flavor_text.firered: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.
flavor_text.heartgold: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavor_text.platinum: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
flavor_text.ruby: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
flavor_text.sapphire: RAYQUAZA is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, above the clouds. Its existence had been completely unknown because it lived so high in the sky.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

flavor_text.diamond: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavor_text.emerald: JIRACHI is said to make wishes come true. While it sleeps, a tough crystalline shell envelops the body to protect it from enemies.
flavor_text.firered: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.
flavor_text.heartgold: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
flavor_text.leafgreen: It is said to make any wish come true. It is awake for only seven days out of a thousand years.
flavor_text.pearl: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
flavor_text.ruby: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
flavor_text.sapphire: JIRACHI will awaken from its sleep of a thousand years if you sing to it in a voice of purity. It is said to make true any wish that people desire.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

flavor_text.diamond: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
flavor_text.emerald: A POKéMON that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
flavor_text.firered: This DEOXYS has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
flavor_text.heartgold: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
flavor_text.leafgreen: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.
flavor_text.pearl: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
flavor_text.platinum: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
flavor_text.ruby: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
flavor_text.sapphire: DEOXYS emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This POKéMON shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
flavor_text.soulsilver: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

flavor_text.diamond: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
flavor_text.heartgold: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
flavor_text.pearl: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
flavor_text.platinum: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
flavor_text.heartgold: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
flavor_text.pearl: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.
flavor_text.platinum: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

flavor_text.diamond: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
flavor_text.heartgold: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic TORTERRA dwelled.
flavor_text.pearl: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for “moving forests.”
flavor_text.platinum: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA’s back and spend their entire life there.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic TORTERRA dwelled.

flavor_text.diamond: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
flavor_text.heartgold: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
flavor_text.pearl: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
flavor_text.platinum: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

flavor_text.diamond: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
flavor_text.heartgold: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.
flavor_text.pearl: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
flavor_text.platinum: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
flavor_text.soulsilver: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.

flavor_text.diamond: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
flavor_text.heartgold: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
flavor_text.pearl: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
flavor_text.platinum: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

flavor_text.diamond: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
flavor_text.heartgold: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.
flavor_text.platinum: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
flavor_text.heartgold: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
flavor_text.pearl: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.
flavor_text.platinum: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.

flavor_text.diamond: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
flavor_text.heartgold: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.
flavor_text.pearl: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
flavor_text.platinum: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.

flavor_text.diamond: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
flavor_text.heartgold: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
flavor_text.pearl: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.
flavor_text.platinum: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
flavor_text.soulsilver: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

flavor_text.diamond: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
flavor_text.heartgold: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
flavor_text.platinum: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a STARAVIA cries noisily.
flavor_text.soulsilver: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

flavor_text.diamond: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
flavor_text.heartgold: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
flavor_text.pearl: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
flavor_text.platinum: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When STARAVIA evolve into STARAPTOR, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

flavor_text.diamond: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
flavor_text.heartgold: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.
flavor_text.pearl: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.
flavor_text.platinum: A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.

flavor_text.diamond: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
flavor_text.heartgold: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
flavor_text.pearl: While its movements out of water are sluggish, it can swim as fast as any FEEBAS.
flavor_text.platinum: A river dammed by BIBAREL will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

flavor_text.diamond: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
flavor_text.heartgold: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
flavor_text.pearl: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
flavor_text.platinum: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

flavor_text.diamond: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
flavor_text.heartgold: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.
flavor_text.pearl: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
flavor_text.platinum: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
flavor_text.soulsilver: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

flavor_text.diamond: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
flavor_text.heartgold: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.
flavor_text.pearl: Its forelegs have a muscle-based system of generating electricity. Its body shines if endangered.
flavor_text.platinum: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

flavor_text.diamond: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
flavor_text.heartgold: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.
flavor_text.pearl: It rests its forelegs on others to communicate with rhythmic electric pulses from its claws.
flavor_text.platinum: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
flavor_text.soulsilver: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

flavor_text.diamond: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
flavor_text.heartgold: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.
flavor_text.pearl: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.
flavor_text.platinum: It can see clearly through walls to track down its prey and seek its lost young.
flavor_text.soulsilver: LUXRAY’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

flavor_text.diamond: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.
flavor_text.platinum: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.

flavor_text.diamond: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.
flavor_text.pearl: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.
flavor_text.platinum: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

flavor_text.diamond: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
flavor_text.heartgold: CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.
flavor_text.pearl: It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its head butts.
flavor_text.platinum: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.
flavor_text.soulsilver: CRANIDOS toughen up their already rock-hard heads by headbutting one another.

flavor_text.diamond: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.
flavor_text.pearl: Its skull is as hard as iron. It is a brute that tears down jungle trees while catching prey.
flavor_text.platinum: If two were to smash their heads together, their foot-thick skulls would keep them from fainting.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
flavor_text.heartgold: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.
flavor_text.pearl: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.
flavor_text.platinum: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

flavor_text.diamond: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
flavor_text.heartgold: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.
flavor_text.pearl: When attacked, they form a wall with their shieldlike faces to protect their young.
flavor_text.platinum: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When attacked, they form a wall. Their rock-hard faces serve to protect them from the attacks.

flavor_text.diamond: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
flavor_text.heartgold: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.
flavor_text.pearl: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
flavor_text.platinum: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.

flavor_text.diamond: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
flavor_text.pearl: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
flavor_text.platinum: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.

flavor_text.diamond: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
flavor_text.heartgold: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.
flavor_text.pearl: It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields and mountains in constant search of floral honey.
flavor_text.platinum: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from COMBEE.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the COMBEE hive.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
flavor_text.heartgold: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.
flavor_text.pearl: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.
flavor_text.platinum: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.
flavor_text.soulsilver: At night, COMBEE sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

flavor_text.diamond: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
flavor_text.heartgold: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.
flavor_text.pearl: When endangered, grubs from its six-cell honeycomb strike back. There is only one in a colony.
flavor_text.platinum: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.

flavor_text.diamond: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
flavor_text.heartgold: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
flavor_text.pearl: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.
flavor_text.platinum: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

flavor_text.diamond: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
flavor_text.heartgold: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.
flavor_text.pearl: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
flavor_text.platinum: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

flavor_text.diamond: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
flavor_text.heartgold: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.
flavor_text.pearl: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
flavor_text.platinum: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
flavor_text.soulsilver: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

flavor_text.diamond: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
flavor_text.heartgold: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.
flavor_text.pearl: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.
flavor_text.platinum: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. STARLY try to peck it off.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

flavor_text.diamond: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
flavor_text.heartgold: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.
flavor_text.pearl: It is docile as a bud, but turns cheerful when it blooms. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.
flavor_text.platinum: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun’s rays with its whole body.
flavor_text.soulsilver: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

flavor_text.diamond: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape has changed to suit its habitat.
flavor_text.platinum: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

flavor_text.diamond: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
flavor_text.heartgold: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
flavor_text.pearl: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.
flavor_text.platinum: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

flavor_text.diamond: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
flavor_text.heartgold: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.
flavor_text.pearl: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.
flavor_text.platinum: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, AMBIPOM rarely uses its hands.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is very difficult to dodge the consecutive strikes of its two tails.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.
flavor_text.pearl: It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.
flavor_text.platinum: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “Signpost for Wandering Spirits.”
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is whispered that any child who mistakes DRIFLOON for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

flavor_text.diamond: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
flavor_text.heartgold: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.
flavor_text.pearl: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.
flavor_text.platinum: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

flavor_text.diamond: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
flavor_text.heartgold: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.
flavor_text.pearl: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.
flavor_text.platinum: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.
flavor_text.soulsilver: You can tell how it feels by the way it rolls its ears. When it’s scared, both ears are rolled up.

flavor_text.diamond: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
flavor_text.heartgold: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.
flavor_text.pearl: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.
flavor_text.platinum: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It sheds its fur twice a year. Its winter fur is soft and fluffy.

flavor_text.diamond: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.
flavor_text.pearl: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.
flavor_text.platinum: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

flavor_text.diamond: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.
flavor_text.pearl: It makes its MURKROW cronies bring it food. It idles its time away, grooming itself in its nest.
flavor_text.platinum: If one utters a deep cry, many MURKROW gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its MURKROW followers.

flavor_text.diamond: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
flavor_text.pearl: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.
flavor_text.platinum: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When it’s happy, GLAMEOW demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

flavor_text.diamond: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
flavor_text.heartgold: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
flavor_text.pearl: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
flavor_text.platinum: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

flavor_text.diamond: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
flavor_text.heartgold: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
flavor_text.pearl: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
flavor_text.platinum: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.

flavor_text.diamond: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
flavor_text.heartgold: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.
flavor_text.pearl: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.
flavor_text.platinum: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

flavor_text.diamond: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
flavor_text.heartgold: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.
flavor_text.pearl: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.
flavor_text.platinum: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

flavor_text.diamond: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
flavor_text.heartgold: Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.
flavor_text.pearl: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.
flavor_text.platinum: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Ancient people believed that the pattern on BRONZOR’s back contained a mysterious power.

flavor_text.diamond: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
flavor_text.heartgold: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.
flavor_text.pearl: It can summon rain clouds. People long ago revered it as the bringer of plentiful harvests.
flavor_text.platinum: It brought rains by opening portals to another world. It was revered as a bringer of plentiful harvests.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Ancient people believed that petitioning BRONZONG for rain was the way to make crops grow.

flavor_text.diamond: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
flavor_text.heartgold: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.
flavor_text.pearl: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.
flavor_text.platinum: It prefers an arid atmosphere. It leaks water that looks like tears when adjusting its moisture level.
flavor_text.soulsilver: In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear to be crying.

flavor_text.diamond: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
flavor_text.heartgold: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
flavor_text.pearl: It likes places where people gather. It mimics foes to confuse them, then makes its getaway.
flavor_text.platinum: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.
flavor_text.soulsilver: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

flavor_text.diamond: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
flavor_text.heartgold: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.
flavor_text.pearl: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.
flavor_text.platinum: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others’ feet and cause them to stumble.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It carefully carries a round, white rock that it thinks is an egg. It’s bothered by how curly its hair looks.

flavor_text.diamond: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
flavor_text.heartgold: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
flavor_text.pearl: It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like a metronome. It imitates human speech.
flavor_text.platinum: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
flavor_text.heartgold: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.
flavor_text.pearl: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.
flavor_text.platinum: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

flavor_text.diamond: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
flavor_text.heartgold: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
flavor_text.pearl: It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold, it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.
flavor_text.platinum: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

flavor_text.diamond: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
flavor_text.heartgold: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.
flavor_text.pearl: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.
flavor_text.platinum: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.
flavor_text.soulsilver: As it digs to expand its nest, it habitually digs up gems that it then hoards in its nest.

flavor_text.diamond: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.
flavor_text.pearl: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said that when one runs at high speed, its wings create blades of wind that can fell nearby trees.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its body is covered in fine scales that reduce drag, enabling it to fly at high speeds.

flavor_text.diamond: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
flavor_text.heartgold: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.
flavor_text.pearl: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.
flavor_text.platinum: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It conceals food under the long fur on its body. It carts around this food stash and swallows it without chewing.

flavor_text.diamond: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
flavor_text.heartgold: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
flavor_text.pearl: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.
flavor_text.platinum: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.
flavor_text.soulsilver: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

flavor_text.diamond: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
flavor_text.heartgold: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.
flavor_text.pearl: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
flavor_text.platinum: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to LUCARIO, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
flavor_text.heartgold: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.
flavor_text.pearl: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.
flavor_text.platinum: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It shrouds itself in sand to ward off germs. It travels easily through the sands of the desert.

flavor_text.diamond: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
flavor_text.heartgold: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.
flavor_text.pearl: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.
flavor_text.platinum: It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth agape as a display of its strength.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

flavor_text.diamond: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
flavor_text.heartgold: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.
flavor_text.pearl: It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.
flavor_text.platinum: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

flavor_text.diamond: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
flavor_text.heartgold: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.
flavor_text.pearl: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.
flavor_text.platinum: Possessing a sturdy build, it takes pride in its strength, taking down foes without using toxins.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

flavor_text.diamond: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
flavor_text.heartgold: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower-back pain.
flavor_text.pearl: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.
flavor_text.platinum: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Fluid squeezed from its finger, albeit poisonous, is a significant ingredient in remedies for lower back pain.

flavor_text.diamond: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
flavor_text.heartgold: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.
flavor_text.pearl: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.
flavor_text.platinum: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges out with its poisonous claws.

flavor_text.diamond: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
flavor_text.heartgold: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.
flavor_text.pearl: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.
flavor_text.platinum: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

flavor_text.diamond: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
flavor_text.heartgold: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.
flavor_text.pearl: The way its two tail fins flutter while it swims has earned it the nickname “BEAUTIFLY of the Sea.”
flavor_text.platinum: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Swimming and fluttering its two tail fins, it looks like a BEAUTIFLY. At night, the patterns on its tail fins softly shine.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
flavor_text.heartgold: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.
flavor_text.pearl: To avoid detection by predators, it crawls along the seafloor using the two fins on its chest.
flavor_text.platinum: It crawls along the seafloor using its long front fins like legs. It competes for food with LANTURN.
flavor_text.soulsilver: LUMINEON swimming in the darkness of the deep sea look like stars shining in the night sky.

flavor_text.diamond: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.
flavor_text.pearl: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.
flavor_text.platinum: People organize tours to see this Pokémon frolic and skim the tops of waves with REMORAID.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When it swims close to the surface of the ocean, people aboard ships are able to observe the pattern on its back.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
flavor_text.heartgold: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
flavor_text.pearl: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.
flavor_text.platinum: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.
flavor_text.soulsilver: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

flavor_text.diamond: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
flavor_text.heartgold: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
flavor_text.pearl: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”
flavor_text.platinum: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

flavor_text.diamond: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
flavor_text.heartgold: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.
flavor_text.pearl: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost- covered trees and ice.
flavor_text.platinum: Evolution made it even more devious. It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

flavor_text.diamond: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
flavor_text.heartgold: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed MAGNETON’s molecular structure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.
flavor_text.pearl: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
flavor_text.platinum: A group tried to use scientific means to make MAGNEZONE evolve, but their efforts ended in failure.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Exposure to a special magnetic field changed MAGNETON’s molecular structure, turning it into MAGNEZONE.

flavor_text.diamond: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its saliva can decompose anything. It wraps its long tongue around things to coat them with its sticky saliva.
flavor_text.pearl: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.
flavor_text.platinum: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

flavor_text.diamond: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
flavor_text.heartgold: From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
flavor_text.pearl: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
flavor_text.platinum: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.
flavor_text.soulsilver: From holes in its palms, it fires out GEODUDE. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

flavor_text.diamond: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
flavor_text.heartgold: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.
flavor_text.pearl: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
flavor_text.platinum: Its arms are made of plants that bind themselves to things. They grow back right away if cut.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can’t even see its eyes.

flavor_text.diamond: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
flavor_text.heartgold: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.
flavor_text.pearl: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
flavor_text.platinum: Heedless of enemy attacks, it closes in, shoves its tails onto the foe, then looses high voltage.
flavor_text.soulsilver: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

flavor_text.diamond: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
flavor_text.heartgold: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.
flavor_text.pearl: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.
flavor_text.platinum: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

flavor_text.diamond: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
flavor_text.heartgold: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
flavor_text.pearl: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
flavor_text.platinum: It shares many blessings with people who respect one another’s rights and avoid needless strife.
flavor_text.soulsilver: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

flavor_text.diamond: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
flavor_text.heartgold: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
flavor_text.pearl: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
flavor_text.platinum: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

flavor_text.diamond: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
flavor_text.heartgold: When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.
flavor_text.pearl: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.
flavor_text.platinum: It basically does not fight. With cells similar to those of plants, it can perform photosynthesis.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When you see LEAFEON asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

flavor_text.diamond: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
flavor_text.heartgold: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.
flavor_text.pearl: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.
flavor_text.platinum: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It causes small ice crystals to form by lowering the temperature of the surrounding atmosphere.

flavor_text.diamond: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
flavor_text.heartgold: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
flavor_text.pearl: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
flavor_text.platinum: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

flavor_text.diamond: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
flavor_text.heartgold: A frozen MAMOSWINE was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
flavor_text.pearl: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
flavor_text.platinum: A frozen one was dug up from soil dating back 10,000 years. It woke up to much amazement.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It flourished worldwide during the ice age but its population declined when the masses of ice began to dwindle.

flavor_text.diamond: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...
flavor_text.pearl: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.
flavor_text.platinum: Its programming was modified to enable work in alien dimensions. It did not work as planned.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error...

flavor_text.diamond: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
flavor_text.heartgold: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
flavor_text.pearl: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
flavor_text.platinum: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

flavor_text.diamond: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
flavor_text.heartgold: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.
flavor_text.pearl: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.
flavor_text.platinum: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It controls three units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force. With them, it can attack the foe from three directions.

flavor_text.diamond: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
flavor_text.heartgold: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.
flavor_text.pearl: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
flavor_text.soulsilver: This feared Pokémon is said to travel to worlds unknown. Some even believe that it takes lost spirits along with it.

flavor_text.diamond: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
flavor_text.heartgold: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS.
flavor_text.pearl: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.
flavor_text.platinum: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Legends in snowy regions say that a woman who was lost on an icy mountain was reborn as FROSLASS

flavor_text.diamond: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
flavor_text.heartgold: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
flavor_text.pearl: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
flavor_text.platinum: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

flavor_text.diamond: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
flavor_text.heartgold: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.
flavor_text.pearl: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
flavor_text.platinum: When UXIE flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
flavor_text.soulsilver: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.

flavor_text.diamond: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
flavor_text.heartgold: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.
flavor_text.pearl: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.
flavor_text.platinum: When MESPRIT flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
flavor_text.soulsilver: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.

flavor_text.diamond: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
flavor_text.heartgold: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.
flavor_text.pearl: It is thought that UXIE, MESPRIT and AZELF all came from the same egg.
flavor_text.platinum: When AZELF flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
flavor_text.soulsilver: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.

flavor_text.diamond: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
flavor_text.heartgold: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when DIALGA was born.
flavor_text.platinum: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA’s heart beats.
flavor_text.soulsilver: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

flavor_text.diamond: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
flavor_text.heartgold: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
flavor_text.pearl: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
flavor_text.platinum: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA’s every breath.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

flavor_text.diamond: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
flavor_text.heartgold: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
flavor_text.pearl: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
flavor_text.platinum: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

flavor_text.diamond: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
flavor_text.heartgold: It is believed to have shaped REGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL out of clay, ice, and magma.
flavor_text.pearl: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It is believed to have shaped REGIROCK, REGICE, and REGISTEEL out of clay, ice, and magma.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
flavor_text.heartgold: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
flavor_text.platinum: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
flavor_text.soulsilver: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

flavor_text.diamond: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavor_text.heartgold: Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavor_text.pearl: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
flavor_text.platinum: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
flavor_text.soulsilver: Those who sleep holding CRESSELIA’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

flavor_text.diamond: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
flavor_text.heartgold: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
flavor_text.pearl: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
flavor_text.platinum: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
flavor_text.soulsilver: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

flavor_text.diamond: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
flavor_text.heartgold: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavor_text.pearl: Water makes up 80% of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.
flavor_text.platinum: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

flavor_text.diamond: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
flavor_text.heartgold: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
flavor_text.pearl: Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokémon will make people see horrific nightmares.
flavor_text.platinum: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
flavor_text.soulsilver: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

flavor_text.diamond: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
flavor_text.heartgold: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
flavor_text.pearl: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
flavor_text.platinum: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
flavor_text.soulsilver: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

flavor_text.diamond: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
flavor_text.heartgold: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
flavor_text.pearl: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
flavor_text.platinum: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
flavor_text.soulsilver: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
